```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { BottomSheet } from './BottomSheet';
import { Loader2, Plus, Phone, MessageSquare, Mail, MapPin, FileText, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

type Activity = {
  id: string;
  activity_type: string;
  outcome: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  next_action: string | null;
  next_follow_up: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  profiles: { username: string } | null;
};

const ACTIVITY_TYPES = [
  'Phone Call',
  'Cold Email',
  'Follow-up Email',
  'WhatsApp Business Message',
  'LinkedIn Message',
  'Other Business Message',
  'In-Person Visit',
  'Discovery Meeting',
  'Follow-up Meeting',
  'Proposal Discussion',
  'Internal Coordination',
  'General Note'
];

const OUTCOMES = [
  'No Answer',
  'Busy',
  'Call Back Requested',
  'Message Sent',
  'Interested',
  'Not Interested',
  'Wrong Contact',
  'Decision-Maker Identified',
  'Meeting Requested',
  'Meeting Confirmed',
  'Needs More Information',
  'Follow-up Required'
];

const ICONS: Record<string, any> = {
  'Phone Call': Phone,
  'Cold Email': Mail,
  'Follow-up Email': Mail,
  'WhatsApp Business Message': MessageSquare,
  'LinkedIn Message': MessageSquare,
  'Other Business Message': MessageSquare,
  'In-Person Visit': MapPin,
  'Discovery Meeting': Clock,
  'Follow-up Meeting': Clock,
  'Proposal Discussion': FileText,
  'Internal Coordination': FileText,
  'General Note': FileText
};

export function ActivityTimeline({ leadId, businessId }: { leadId: string; businessId?: string }) {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const [activities, setActivities] = useState<Activity[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showSheet, setShowSheet] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [activityType, setActivityType] = useState('Phone Call');
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [nextAction, setNextAction] = useState('');
  const [nextFollowUp, setNextFollowUp] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchActivities();
  }, [leadId]);

  async function fetchActivities() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('sales_activities')
      .select('id, activity_type, outcome, notes, next_action, next_follow_up, created_at, profiles(username)')
      .eq('lead_id', leadId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (data) setActivities(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleSave(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('sales_activities').insert({
      lead_id: leadId,
      business_id: businessId || null,
      created_by: profile.id,
      activity_type: activityType,
      outcome: outcome || null,
      notes: notes || null,
      next_action: nextAction || null,
      next_follow_up: nextFollowUp || null
    });
    if (!error) {
      setOutcome('');
      setNotes('');
      setNextAction('');
      setNextFollowUp('');
      setShowSheet(false);
      fetchActivities();
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h4 className="text-[14px] font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Clock size={16} /> Activity</h4>
        <button onClick={() => setShowSheet(true)} className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-brand-primary flex items-center gap-1">
          <Plus size={16} /> Log
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center py-4"><Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-primary" size={20} /></div>
      ) : activities.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">No activity yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3 relative border-l-2 border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark ml-2 pl-4">
          {activities.map(a => {
            const Icon = ICONS[a.activity_type] || FileText;
            return (
              <div key={a.id} className="relative">
                <div className="absolute -left-[21px] top-1.5 w-3 h-3 bg-brand-primary rounded-full border-2 border-surface-cardLight dark:border-surface-cardDark"></div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Icon size={14} className="text-brand-primary" />
                  <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{a.activity_type}</p>
                </div>
                {a.outcome && <p className="text-[12px] font-medium text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">Outcome: {a.outcome}</p>}
                {a.notes && <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">{a.notes}</p>}
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark mt-0.5">
                  by {a.profiles?.username} • {new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet isOpen={showSheet} onClose={() => setShowSheet(false)} title="Log Activity">
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[12px] font-semibold mb-1">Type</label>
            <select value={activityType} onChange={e => setActivityType(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full">
              {ACTIVITY_TYPES.map(t => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[12px] font-semibold mb-1">Outcome</label>
            <select value={outcome} onChange={e => setOutcome(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full">
              <option value="">—</option>
              {OUTCOMES.map(o => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <textarea placeholder="Notes" value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={3} />
          <input type="text" placeholder="Next action" value={nextAction} onChange={e => setNextAction(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" />
          <input type="date" value={nextFollowUp} onChange={e => setNextFollowUp(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" />
          <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="w-full h-[44px] bg-brand-primary text-black font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform disabled:opacity-70">
            {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={18} /> : 'Save Activity'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

type Props = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: string;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
};

export function BottomSheet({ isOpen, onClose, title, footer, children }: Props) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(isOpen);
  const [translateY, setTranslateY] = useState(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [keyboardOffset, setKeyboardOffset] = useState(0);
  const startYRef = useRef(0);
  const titleId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setVisible(true);
      setTranslateY(0);
    } else if (visible) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), 240);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  }, [isOpen, visible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    const original = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = original; };
  }, [visible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) { setKeyboardOffset(0); return; }
    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    if (!vv) return;
    const handler = () => {
      const kb = window.innerHeight - vv.height - vv.offsetTop;
      setKeyboardOffset(Math.max(0, kb));
    };
    vv.addEventListener('resize', handler);
    vv.addEventListener('scroll', handler);
    handler();
    return () => {
      vv.removeEventListener('resize', handler);
      vv.removeEventListener('scroll', handler);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!visible) return null;

  function handleBackdropClick() {
    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    if (active && (active.tagName === 'INPUT' || active.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || active.tagName === 'SELECT')) {
      active.blur();
      return;
    }
    onClose();
  }

  function handleTouchStart(e: React.TouchEvent) {
    startYRef.current = e.touches[0].clientY - translateY;
    setIsDragging(true);
  }
  function handleTouchMove(e: React.TouchEvent) {
    const delta = e.touches[0].clientY - startYRef.current;
    if (delta > 0) setTranslateY(delta);
  }
  function handleTouchEnd() {
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (translateY > 120) {
      onClose();
    } else {
      setTranslateY(0);
    }
  }

  const slideOffset = isOpen ? translateY : 1000;

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end md:items-center justify-center md:p-6" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={title ? titleId : undefined}>
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/65 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all duration-300"
        style={{
          opacity: isOpen ? 1 : 0,
          transitionProperty: 'opacity',
          transitionDuration: '200ms',
        }}
        onClick={handleBackdropClick}
      />
      <div
        className="relative w-full md:max-w-[560px] bg-surface-elevatedLight dark:bg-surface-elevatedDark rounded-t-[2rem] md:rounded-2xl shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] md:shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] dark:shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] dark:md:shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] border-t border-x md:border border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark flex flex-col max-h-[88dvh] overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          transform: `translateY(${slideOffset}px)`,
          transitionProperty: 'transform',
          transitionDuration: isDragging ? '0ms' : '240ms',
          transitionTimingFunction: 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
          bottom: keyboardOffset,
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-3 pb-3 border-b border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark shrink-0"
          style={{ touchAction: 'none' }}
          onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
          onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
          onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
        >
          <div className="w-9" />
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-10 h-1 bg-black/15 dark:bg-white/20 rounded-full mb-2 md:hidden" />
            {title && (
              <h2 id={titleId} className="text-[17px] font-bold truncate max-w-full px-2 tracking-tight">
                {title}
              </h2>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark active:bg-black/5 dark:active:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div
          className="overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-5 pt-4 flex-1 min-h-0"
          style={{ paddingBottom: footer ? '1rem' : 'calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' }}
        >
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <div
            className="shrink-0 border-t border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark px-4 py-3 bg-surface-elevatedLight dark:bg-surface-elevatedDark md:rounded-b-2xl"
            style={{ paddingBottom: 'calc(0.75rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' }}
          >
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import {
  Search, Command, ArrowRight, Building2, Loader2,
  LayoutDashboard, Target, Layers, ListTodo, Calendar, Wrench,
  DollarSign, FileText, BookOpen, Flag, Bell, BarChart3, Map as MapIcon,
  GraduationCap, Users, Shield, Globe, Lock, Trophy, Home, User,
} from 'lucide-react';

type Category = 'Workspace' | 'Sales' | 'Enablement' | 'Community' | 'Administration' | 'Account';

type PageItem = {
  kind: 'page';
  path: string;
  label: string;
  category: Category;
  icon: any;
  keywords?: string;
  adminOnly?: boolean;
};

type LeadHit = {
  kind: 'lead';
  id: string;
  name: string;
  industry: string | null;
};

const ALL_PAGES: Omit<PageItem, 'kind'>[] = [
  { path: '/dashboard', label: 'Home', category: 'Workspace', icon: LayoutDashboard, keywords: 'dashboard overview today' },
  { path: '/leads', label: 'Leads', category: 'Workspace', icon: Target, keywords: 'crm prospects accounts' },
  { path: '/pipeline', label: 'Pipeline', category: 'Workspace', icon: Layers, keywords: 'kanban stages board' },
  { path: '/tasks', label: 'Tasks', category: 'Workspace', icon: ListTodo, keywords: 'todo follow-up reminders' },
  { path: '/meetings', label: 'Meetings', category: 'Workspace', icon: Calendar, keywords: 'calendar schedule calls' },
  { path: '/technical-handovers', label: 'Handovers', category: 'Sales', icon: Wrench, keywords: 'technical requests assessment' },
  { path: '/deals', label: 'Deals', category: 'Sales', icon: DollarSign, keywords: 'opportunities revenue value' },
  { path: '/proposals', label: 'Proposals', category: 'Sales', icon: FileText, keywords: 'offers quotes approval' },
  { path: '/targets', label: 'Targets', category: 'Sales', icon: Flag, keywords: 'goals quota objectives' },
  { path: '/services', label: 'Services', category: 'Enablement', icon: BookOpen, keywords: 'catalogue products what we sell' },
  { path: '/playbooks', label: 'Playbooks', category: 'Enablement', icon: MapIcon, keywords: 'scripts templates market' },
  { path: '/training', label: 'Training', category: 'Enablement', icon: GraduationCap, keywords: 'learning modules onboarding' },
  { path: '/reports', label: 'Reports', category: 'Enablement', icon: BarChart3, keywords: 'analytics metrics performance' },
  { path: '/updates', label: 'Updates', category: 'Community', icon: Home, keywords: 'announcements news feed' },
  { path: '/resources', label: 'Resources', category: 'Community', icon: FileText, keywords: 'documents pdf files library' },
  { path: '/leaderboard', label: 'Leaderboard', category: 'Community', icon: Trophy, keywords: 'ranking points top' },
  { path: '/teams', label: 'Teams', category: 'Administration', icon: Users, adminOnly: true, keywords: 'team management members' },
  { path: '/command-center', label: 'Command Center', category: 'Administration', icon: Globe, adminOnly: true, keywords: 'global overview operations' },
  { path: '/commercial-records', label: 'Commercial Records', category: 'Administration', icon: Lock, adminOnly: true, keywords: 'compensation confidential' },
  { path: '/audit-logs', label: 'Audit Logs', category: 'Administration', icon: Shield, adminOnly: true, keywords: 'history events trail' },
  { path: '/admin', label: 'Administration', category: 'Administration', icon: Shield, adminOnly: true, keywords: 'ids users access settings' },
  { path: '/notifications', label: 'Notifications', category: 'Account', icon: Bell, keywords: 'alerts unread' },
  { path: '/profile', label: 'Profile', category: 'Account', icon: User, keywords: 'account me settings' },
];

export function CommandPalette() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const [leadHits, setLeadHits] = useState<LeadHit[]>([]);
  const [leadLoading, setLeadLoading] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    function keyHandler(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen(o => !o);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    }
    function openHandler() { setOpen(true); }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);
    window.addEventListener('bxb:open-command-palette', openHandler);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);
      window.removeEventListener('bxb:open-command-palette', openHandler);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setQuery('');
      setActiveIndex(0);
      setLeadHits([]);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 30);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
    }
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const q = query.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
      setLeadHits([]);
      setLeadLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setLeadLoading(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('businesses')
        .select('id, name, industry')
        .ilike('name', `%${q}%`)
        .limit(6);
      if (cancelled) return;
      setLeadHits(((data as any[]) || []).map(b => ({
        kind: 'lead' as const,
        id: b.id,
        name: b.name,
        industry: b.industry,
      })));
      setLeadLoading(false);
    }, 250);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [query, open]);

  const filteredPages = useMemo(() => {
    const pool = ALL_PAGES.filter(i => !i.adminOnly || isAdmin);
    if (!query.trim()) return pool;
    const q = query.toLowerCase();
    return pool.filter(i =>
      i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (i.keywords || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      i.category.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [query, isAdmin]);

  const flat: (PageItem | LeadHit)[] = useMemo(() => {
    const pages: PageItem[] = filteredPages.map(p => ({ kind: 'page', ...p }));
    return [...leadHits, ...pages];
  }, [filteredPages, leadHits]);

  useEffect(() => { setActiveIndex(0); }, [query]);

  function activate(item: PageItem | LeadHit) {
    if (item.kind === 'page') navigate(item.path);
    else navigate('/leads', { state: { search: item.name } });
    setOpen(false);
  }

  function onKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex(i => Math.min(i + 1, flat.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex(i => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && flat[activeIndex]) {
      e.preventDefault();
      activate(flat[activeIndex]);
    }
  }

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new globalThis.Map<Category, { item: PageItem; idx: number }[]>();
    filteredPages.forEach((p, i) => {
      const item: PageItem = { kind: 'page', ...p };
      const idx = leadHits.length + i;
      if (!map.has(item.category)) map.set(item.category, []);
      map.get(item.category)!.push({ item, idx });
    });
    return Array.from(map.entries());
  }, [filteredPages, leadHits.length]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const hasResults = filteredPages.length > 0 || leadHits.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-start justify-center pt-[15vh] px-4" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-[560px] bg-surface-elevatedLight dark:bg-surface-elevatedDark rounded-2xl border border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark shadow-float dark:shadow-floatDark overflow-hidden animate-enter">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 h-[52px] border-b border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark">
          <Search size={16} className="text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            value={query}
            onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
            placeholder="Search pages, leads, actions…"
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-[14px] outline-none placeholder:text-text-mutedLight dark:placeholder:text-text-mutedDark"
          />
          {leadLoading ? (
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center text-[10px] font-mono text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark border border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark rounded px-1.5 h-[20px]">ESC</kbd>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto py-1">
          {!hasResults ? (
            <div className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-[13px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark">
              No results for "{query}"
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {leadHits.length > 0 && (
                <div className="py-1">
                  <p className="eyebrow px-4 py-1">Leads</p>
                  {leadHits.map((hit, i) => {
                    const active = i === activeIndex;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={`lead-${hit.id}`}
                        onClick={() => activate(hit)}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(i)}
                        className={
                          'w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-left transition-colors ' +
                          (active ? 'bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary' : 'hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5')
                        }
                      >
                        <Building2 size={16} className={active ? 'text-brand-primary shrink-0' : 'text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0'} />
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-[13px] font-medium tracking-tight truncate">{hit.name}</p>
                          {hit.industry && <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark truncate">{hit.industry}</p>}
                        </div>
                        {active && <ArrowRight size={14} className="text-brand-primary shrink-0" />}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
              {groups.map(([category, entries]) => (
                <div key={category} className="py-1">
                  <p className="eyebrow px-4 py-1">{category}</p>
                  {entries.map(({ item, idx }) => {
                    const active = idx === activeIndex;
                    const Icon = item.icon;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={item.path}
                        onClick={() => activate(item)}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(idx)}
                        className={
                          'w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-left transition-colors ' +
                          (active ? 'bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary' : 'hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5')
                        }
                      >
                        <Icon size={16} className={active ? 'text-brand-primary shrink-0' : 'text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0'} />
                        <span className="text-[13px] font-medium tracking-tight flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
                        {active && <ArrowRight size={14} className="text-brand-primary shrink-0" />}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </>
          )}
        </div>

import { Component } from 'react';
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ShieldAlert, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    // Log the error to an error reporting service or console
    console.error('Uncaught component error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="p-8 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60dvh] animate-enter">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-state-dangerSoft text-state-danger rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-5 shadow-sm">
            <ShieldAlert size={32} />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-[22px] font-bold tracking-tight mb-2">Something went wrong</h1>
          <p className="text-[14px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            {this.state.error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page.'}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
            className="btn-primary w-auto px-6"
          >
            <RotateCcw size={16} />
            Reload Application
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, UserCheck, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

type Member = { id: string; username: string; role: string };

export function LeadAssignment({
  leadId,
  currentAssignee,
  teamId,
  onChanged
}: {
  leadId: string;
  currentAssignee: string | null;
  teamId: string;
  onChanged?: () => void;
}) {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const canManage = profile?.role === 'admin' || profile?.role === 'team_leader';
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<Member[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string>(currentAssignee || '');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { fetchMembers(); }, [teamId]);
  useEffect(() => { setSelected(currentAssignee || ''); }, [currentAssignee]);

  async function fetchMembers() {
    if (!teamId || teamId === 'undefined' || teamId === 'null' || teamId.trim() === '') {
      setLoading(false);
      setMembers([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    // Removed the .in('role', [...]) filter to prevent ENUM mismatch errors.
    // We just fetch everyone in the team.
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id, username, role')
      .eq('team_id', teamId);
      
    if (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching team members:", error.message);
    }
    
    if (data) setMembers(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleReassign() {
    if (!profile || !selected) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setMsg('');
    const previous = currentAssignee;
    const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('leads')
      .update({ assigned_to: selected })
      .eq('id', leadId);
    if (updateErr) { setMsg(updateErr.message); setSaving(false); return; }
    const { error: assignErr } = await supabase.from('lead_assignments').insert({
      lead_id: leadId,
      from_user: previous || null,
      to_user: selected,
      changed_by: profile.id
    });
    if (assignErr) console.error('Failed to log assignment history:', assignErr);
    // Audit log is now handled automatically by the DB trigger
    setMsg('Reassigned successfully.');
    if (onChanged) onChanged();
    setSaving(false);
  }

  if (!canManage) return null;

  if (loading) return <div className="py-2 flex justify-center"><Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-primary" size={16} /></div>;

  if (members.length === 0) return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <h4 className="text-[14px] font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><UserCheck size={16} /> Assignment</h4>
      <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
        {!teamId ? "This lead is not assigned to a team yet." : "No other team members available to assign."}
      </p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <h4 className="text-[14px] font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><UserCheck size={16} /> Assignment</h4>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <select
          value={selected}
          onChange={e => setSelected(e.target.value)}
          className="input-field flex-1"
        >
          <option value="">Unassigned</option>
          {members.map(m => (
            <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.username} ({m.role})</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <button
          onClick={handleReassign}
          disabled={saving || !selected || selected === currentAssignee}
          className="h-[40px] px-3 bg-brand-primary text-black font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <><RefreshCw size={13} /> Reassign</>}
        </button>
      </div>
      {msg && <p className="text-[12px] text-brand-primary">{msg}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, ClipboardCheck, Save } from 'lucide-react';

type Qualification = {
  id: string;
  lead_id: string;
  business_fit: string | null;
  identified_problem: string | null;
  decision_maker: string | null;
  interest_level: string | null;
  commercial_readiness: string | null;
  score: number | null;
  missing_info: string | null;
  recommended_action: string | null;
  is_complete: boolean;
  review_status: string;
  review_notes: string | null;
};

export function LeadQualification({ leadId }: { leadId: string }) {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';
  const [q, setQ] = useState<Qualification | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const [businessFit, setBusinessFit] = useState('');
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState('');
  const [decisionMaker, setDecisionMaker] = useState('');
  const [interest, setInterest] = useState('');
  const [commercial, setCommercial] = useState('');
  const [missingInfo, setMissingInfo] = useState('');
  const [recommended, setRecommended] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { fetchQ(); }, [leadId]);

  async function fetchQ() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('lead_qualifications')
      .select('*')
      .eq('lead_id', leadId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (data) {
      setQ(data as any);
      setBusinessFit(data.business_fit || '');
      setProblem(data.identified_problem || '');
      setDecisionMaker(data.decision_maker || '');
      setInterest(data.interest_level || '');
      setCommercial(data.commercial_readiness || '');
      setMissingInfo(data.missing_info || '');
      setRecommended(data.recommended_action || '');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }

  function computeScore() {
    let s = 0;
    if (businessFit.trim()) s += 20;
    if (problem.trim()) s += 20;
    if (decisionMaker.trim()) s += 20;
    if (interest.trim()) s += 20;
    if (commercial.trim()) s += 20;
    return s;
  }

  async function handleSave(markComplete: boolean) {
    if (!profile) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setMsg('');
    const payload = {
      lead_id: leadId,
      business_fit: businessFit || null,
      identified_problem: problem || null,
      decision_maker: decisionMaker || null,
      interest_level: interest || null,
      commercial_readiness: commercial || null,
      score: computeScore(),
      missing_info: missingInfo || null,
      recommended_action: recommended || null,
      is_complete: markComplete,
      review_status: markComplete ? 'Submitted' : (q?.review_status || 'Draft'),
      created_by: profile.id,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    let error;
    if (q) {
      ({ error } = await supabase.from('lead_qualifications').update(payload).eq('id', q.id));
    } else {
      ({ error } = await supabase.from('lead_qualifications').insert(payload));
    }
    if (!error) {
      setMsg(markComplete ? 'Submitted for review.' : 'Draft saved.');
      fetchQ();
    } else {
      setMsg(error.message);
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleReview(status: 'Approved' | 'Returned') {
    if (!q || !profile) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('lead_qualifications').update({
      review_status: status,
      reviewed_by: profile.id,
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }).eq('id', q.id);
    if (!error) fetchQ();
    setSaving(false);
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="py-3 flex justify-center"><Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-primary" size={18} /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h4 className="text-[14px] font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><ClipboardCheck size={16} /> Qualification</h4>
        {q && (
          <span className={'text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase tracking-wider ' + (q.review_status === 'Approved' ? 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-500' : q.review_status === 'Returned' ? 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-500' : q.review_status === 'Submitted' ? 'bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-500' : 'bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5')}>
            {q.review_status}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Business fit</label>
        <textarea value={businessFit} onChange={e => setBusinessFit(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={2} placeholder="Genuine business? Fits BXB target market? Use case exists?" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Identified problem</label>
        <textarea value={problem} onChange={e => setProblem(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={2} placeholder="What is the business trying to improve?" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Decision-maker</label>
        <textarea value={decisionMaker} onChange={e => setDecisionMaker(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={2} placeholder="Right person identified? Meeting possible?" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Interest</label>
        <textarea value={interest} onChange={e => setInterest(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={2} placeholder="Actual interest expressed? Requested info?" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Commercial readiness</label>
        <textarea value={commercial} onChange={e => setCommercial(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" rows={2} placeholder="Budget (if offered), timeline, active planning?" />
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Missing info</label>
          <input value={missingInfo} onChange={e => setMissingInfo(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1">Recommended next step</label>
          <input value={recommended} onChange={e => setRecommended(e.target.value)} className="input-field w-full" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
        <span>Score: <strong>{computeScore()}</strong> / 100</span>
      </div>

      {msg && <p className="text-[12px] text-brand-primary">{msg}</p>}

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button onClick={() => handleSave(false)} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 h-[38px] bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 font-semibold rounded-xl text-[13px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
          {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <><Save size={13} /> Save Draft</>}
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => handleSave(true)} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 h-[38px] bg-brand-primary text-black font-bold rounded-xl text-[13px]">
          Submit for Review
        </button>
      </div>

      {isAdmin && q?.review_status === 'Submitted' && (
        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
          <button onClick={() => handleReview('Approved')} className="flex-1 h-[36px] bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 font-semibold rounded-xl text-[12px]">Approve</button>
          <button onClick={() => handleReview('Returned')} className="flex-1 h-[36px] bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 font-semibold rounded-xl text-[12px]">Return</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

type ModalProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
};

export function Modal({ isOpen, onClose, title, subtitle, children, footer }: ModalProps) {
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      const focusableElements = modalRef.current?.querySelectorAll(
        'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
      );
      if (focusableElements && focusableElements.length > 0) {
        ((modalRef.current?.querySelector('input, textarea, select') as HTMLElement | null) ?? (focusableElements[0] as HTMLElement)).focus();
      }
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    if (isOpen) window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center sm:p-6">
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-[6px] transition-opacity"
        onClick={onClose}
      />
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        className="relative w-full max-w-[520px] max-h-[calc(100dvh-0px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-48px)] bg-surface-elevatedLight dark:bg-surface-elevatedDark border border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark sm:rounded-2xl rounded-t-2xl shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] flex flex-col animate-modal-enter"
      >
        <div className="w-full flex justify-center pt-3 pb-1 sm:hidden">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 bg-black/15 dark:bg-white/20 rounded-full" />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-start justify-between px-6 py-5 border-b border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark shrink-0">
          <div>
            <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-[20px] font-semibold text-text-primaryLight dark:text-text-primaryDark tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
            {subtitle && <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark mt-1">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-text-primaryLight dark:hover:text-text-primaryDark transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary"
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-6">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <div className="shrink-0 px-6 py-4 border-t border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark bg-surface-elevatedLight dark:bg-surface-elevatedDark sm:rounded-b-2xl">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import type { WheelEvent } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Document, Page, pdfjs } from 'react-pdf';
import type { PDFDocumentProxy } from 'pdfjs-dist';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, Download, Loader2, Plus, Minus } from 'lucide-react';
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/AnnotationLayer.css';
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/TextLayer.css';
import workerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';

pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerUrl;

const observerOptions = { rootMargin: '200px' };
const pixelRatio = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2) : 1;

function useIntersectionObserver(options: IntersectionObserverInit) {
  const [isIntersecting, setIsIntersecting] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        setIsIntersecting(true);
        observer.disconnect();
      }
    }, options);
    if (ref.current) observer.observe(ref.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [options]);
  return [ref, isIntersecting] as const;
}

const LazyPage = memo(({ pageNumber, width, scale, aspectRatio }: { pageNumber: number, width: number, scale: number, aspectRatio: number }) => {
  const [ref, inView] = useIntersectionObserver(observerOptions);
  const [hasRendered, setHasRendered] = useState(false);
  
  const finalWidth = width * scale;
  const finalHeight = finalWidth * aspectRatio;

  return (
    <div 
      ref={ref} 
      data-page={pageNumber}
      className="pdf-page-wrapper flex justify-center w-full shrink-0 relative" 
      style={{ height: finalHeight, minHeight: finalHeight, width: finalWidth, flexShrink: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}
    >
      {inView && (
        <Page 
          pageNumber={pageNumber} 
          width={width} 
          scale={scale} 
          renderAnnotationLayer={false}
          renderTextLayer={false}
          devicePixelRatio={pixelRatio}
          className="border border-white/10"
          onRenderSuccess={() => setHasRendered(true)}
          loading={<div style={{ width: finalWidth, height: finalHeight }} />}
        />
      )}
      {!hasRendered && (
        <div 
          className="bg-white/5 absolute inset-0" 
          style={{ width: finalWidth, height: finalHeight }} 
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

const PdfViewer = memo(function PdfViewer({ fileUrl, title, onClose }: { fileUrl: string, title: string, onClose: () => void }) {
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false);
  const [pdfWidth, setPdfWidth] = useState(() => Math.min(window.innerWidth - 40, 1000));
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);
  const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [showPill, setShowPill] = useState(true);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
  const pillTimeoutRef = useRef<any>(null);

  onCloseRef.current = onClose;

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = 'unset'; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onCloseRef.current(); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!numPages) setTimedOut(true);
    }, 15000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [numPages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: any;
    let lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
    
    const handleResize = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        if (Math.abs(window.innerWidth - lastWidth) >= 100) {
          lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
          setPdfWidth(Math.min(lastWidth - 40, 1000));
        }
      }, 300);
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize); clearTimeout(timeoutId); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current || !numPages) return;
    
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      let maxRatio = 0;
      let page = currentPage;
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > maxRatio) {
          maxRatio = entry.intersectionRatio;
          page = Number(entry.target.getAttribute('data-page'));
        }
      });
      if (maxRatio > 0) {
         setCurrentPage(prev => prev !== page ? page : prev);
      }
    }, { root: containerRef.current, threshold: [0, 0.1, 0.5, 1] });

    const pages = containerRef.current.querySelectorAll('.pdf-page-wrapper');
    pages.forEach(p => observer.observe(p));

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [numPages]);

      setScale(prev => Math.min(Math.max(prev - e.deltaY * 0.01, 0.5), 3));

    });

  const handleError = useCallback(() => {

  }, []);

  const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {
    setShowPill(true);
    if (pillTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(pillTimeoutRef.current);
    pillTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => setShowPill(false), 1500);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    handleScroll();
    return () => clearTimeout(pillTimeoutRef.current);
  }, []);

  const ready = aspectRatio !== null;
  
  const content = (
    <motion.div 
      initial={{ y: '100%', opacity: 0 }} 
      animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} 
      exit={{ y: '100%', opacity: 0 }}

    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 md:p-4 bg-surface-dark border-b border-white/10 shrink-0 z-10">
        <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition">
          <X size={24} />
        </button>
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-[15px] truncate flex-1 mx-4 text-center text-white">{title}</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => setScale(prev => Math.max(prev - 0.25, 0.5))} className="p-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition hidden md:block"><Minus size={20} /></button>
          <button onClick={() => setScale(prev => Math.min(prev + 0.25, 3))} className="p-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition hidden md:block"><Plus size={20} /></button>
          <a href={fileUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="p-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition">
            <Download size={22} />
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div 
        ref={containerRef}
        className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden flex flex-col items-center py-6 gap-3 bg-[#1A1A1A] relative"
        style={{ scrollbarGutter: 'stable', overflowAnchor: 'none' }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} 
        onScroll={handleScroll}
      >
        {error || timedOut ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center px-6">
            <p className="text-white/70 mb-4">Sorry, we couldn't load the preview.</p>
            <a href={fileUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="bg-brand-primary text-black font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-brand-primaryHover transition">
              <Download size={18} /> Download PDF
            </a>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Document
            file={fileUrl}
            onLoadSuccess={handleLoadSuccess}
            onLoadError={handleError}
            loading={
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center mt-20">
                <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-primary mb-4" size={32} />
                <p className="text-white/50 text-sm">Loading document...</p>
              </div>
            }
          >
            {ready && numPages && Array.from(new Array(numPages), (_, index) => (
              <LazyPage 
                key={`page_${index + 1}`} 
                pageNumber={index + 1} 
                width={pdfWidth} 
                scale={scale} 
                aspectRatio={aspectRatio!}
              />
            ))}
          </Document>
        )}
      </div>
      
      {numPages && (
        <div className={`absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-black/80 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-white text-xs font-semibold pointer-events-none z-10 transition-opacity duration-300 ${showPill ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`}>
          {currentPage} / {numPages}
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );

  return createPortal(content, document.body);
});

export default PdfViewer;

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Download, WifiOff, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

export function PWAPrompts() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<any>(null);
  const [showInstall, setShowInstall] = useState(false);
  const [isOffline, setIsOffline] = useState(!navigator.onLine);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: any) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e);
      if (!localStorage.getItem('pwa-dismissed')) {
        setTimeout(() => setShowInstall(true), 3000);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);

    const onOnline = () => setIsOffline(false);
    const onOffline = () => setIsOffline(true);
    window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', onOffline);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);
      window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', onOffline);
    };
  }, []);

  async function handleInstall() {
    if (!deferredPrompt) return;
    deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    if (outcome === 'accepted') setShowInstall(false);
    setDeferredPrompt(null);
  }

  function handleDismiss() {
    setShowInstall(false);
    setDismissed(true);
    localStorage.setItem('pwa-dismissed', 'true');
  }

  return (
    <>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOffline && (
          <motion.div initial={{y: -50, opacity: 0}} animate={{y: 0, opacity: 1}} exit={{y: -50, opacity: 0}} className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[150] bg-red-500 text-white px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold shadow-md">
            <WifiOff size={16} /> You are offline. Showing cached data.
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {showInstall && !dismissed && (
          <motion.div initial={{y: 100, opacity: 0}} animate={{y: 0, opacity: 1}} exit={{y: 100, opacity: 0}} className="fixed bottom-[90px] left-4 right-4 z-[90] bg-surface-cardLight dark:bg-surface-cardDark border border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-float flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <Download size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="font-bold text-[14px] leading-tight">Install BXB Team</p>
                <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">Add to home screen</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button onClick={handleDismiss} className="p-2 text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark hover:text-red-500 transition">
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleInstall} className="bg-brand-primary text-black px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-bold active:scale-95 transition">
                Install
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Plus, Target, Calendar, ListTodo, Wrench } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from './BottomSheet';

type Action = {
  label: string;
  icon: any;
  path: string;
};

const ACTIONS: Action[] = [
  { label: 'Add Lead', icon: Target, path: '/leads' },
  { label: 'Schedule Meeting', icon: Calendar, path: '/meetings' },
  { label: 'Create Task', icon: ListTodo, path: '/tasks' },
  { label: 'Technical Request', icon: Wrench, path: '/technical-handovers' },
];

export function QuickAction() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  function go(a: Action) {
    setOpen(false);
    navigate(a.path, { state: { openCreate: true } });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        aria-label="Quick action"
        className="md:hidden fixed right-4 bottom-[calc(80px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,20px))] w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-brand-primary text-black shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center z-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform"
      >
        <Plus size={24} strokeWidth={2.5} />
      </button>

      <BottomSheet isOpen={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Quick Action">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pb-2">
          {ACTIONS.map(a => (
            <button
              key={a.label}
              onClick={() => go(a)}
              className="card p-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition-transform"
            >
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                <a.icon size={20} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-center leading-tight">{a.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
}

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Info, X } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastKind = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

type Toast = {
  id: number;
  kind: ToastKind;
  text: string;
};

type ToastApi = {
  success: (text: string, duration?: number) => void;
  error: (text: string, duration?: number) => void;
  warning: (text: string, duration?: number) => void;
  info: (text: string, duration?: number) => void;
};

const ToastCtx = createContext<ToastApi | null>(null);

export function useToast(): ToastApi {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastCtx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useToast must be used inside ToastProvider');
  return ctx;
}

const ICON = {
  success: CheckCircle2,
  error: AlertCircle,
  warning: AlertTriangle,
  info: Info,
} as const;

const TONE = {
  success: 'text-state-success bg-state-successSoft border-state-success/30',
  error: 'text-state-danger bg-state-dangerSoft border-state-danger/30',
  warning: 'text-state-warning bg-state-warningSoft border-state-warning/30',
  info: 'text-state-info bg-state-infoSoft border-state-info/30',
} as const;

const MAX_VISIBLE = 3;

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const push = useCallback((kind: ToastKind, text: string, duration = 4000) => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts(prev => [...prev, { id, kind, text }].slice(-MAX_VISIBLE));
    if (duration > 0) {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
      }, duration);
    }
  }, []);

  const api: ToastApi = {
    success: (t, d) => push('success', t, d),
    error: (t, d) => push('error', t, d ?? 6000),
    warning: (t, d) => push('warning', t, d ?? 5000),
    info: (t, d) => push('info', t, d),
  };

  return (
    <ToastCtx.Provider value={api}>
      {children}
      <div
        className="fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[95] flex flex-col gap-2 w-[calc(100%-2rem)] max-w-[400px] pointer-events-none bottom-[calc(88px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,20px))] md:bottom-6"
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        {toasts.map(t => {
          const Icon = ICON[t.kind];
          const role = t.kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status';
          return (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              role={role}
              className={
                'pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 shadow-float dark:shadow-floatDark animate-enter ' +
                TONE[t.kind]
              }
            >
              <Icon size={16} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="flex-1 text-[13px] font-medium leading-snug">{t.text}</p>
              <button
                onClick={() => dismiss(t.id)}
                aria-label="Dismiss"
                className="shrink-0 -mr-1 p-1 rounded-md opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
              >
                <X size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastCtx.Provider>
  );
}

### File: src\context\AuthContext.tsx
```typescript
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import type { Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

type Profile = { id: string; username: string; role: string; avatar_url: string; user_id_code: string; team_id: string; };
type AuthContextType = { session: Session | null; profile: Profile | null; loading: boolean; };
const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({ session: null, profile: null, loading: true });

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<Profile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      if (!session) setLoading(false);
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, newSession) => {
      setSession(prev => {
        if (prev && newSession && prev.user.id === newSession.user.id) {
          console.log('AuthContext: session ignored');
          return prev;
        }
        console.log('AuthContext: session changed');
        return newSession;
      });
      if (!newSession) {
        setProfile(null);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Added optional chaining to user and strict checks for "undefined"/"null" strings
    const userId = session?.user?.id;
    
    if (!userId || typeof userId !== 'string' || userId === 'undefined' || userId === 'null' || userId.trim() === '') {
      if (!session) setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    async function fetchProfile() {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', userId)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching profile:", error.message);
        } else if (data) {
          setProfile(prev => {
            if (prev?.id === data.id && prev?.username === data.username && prev?.role === data.role && prev?.avatar_url === data.avatar_url) {
              return prev;
            }
            return data;
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Unexpected error fetching profile:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    fetchProfile();
  }, [session?.user?.id]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ session, profile, loading }), [session, profile, loading]);
  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}
export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);
