import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { Loader2, Sun, Moon, ArrowRight, Camera, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';
import { usePWAInstall } from '../hooks/usePWAInstall';
import { PWAInstallButton } from '../components/PWAInstallButton';

export default function Login() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isInstalled, promptInstall } = usePWAInstall();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'claim'>('login');

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [avatar, setAvatar] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      return (localStorage.getItem('bxb-theme') as 'light' | 'dark') || 'dark';
    }
    return 'dark';
  });

  // Force clear inputs on mount to defeat browser auto-fill
  useEffect(() => {
    setUserId('');
    setPassword('');
    setUsername('');
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = window.document.documentElement;
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      root.classList.add('dark');
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
    }
    localStorage.setItem('bxb-theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');

  async function handleLogin(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!userId || !password) return;
    setLoading(true);

    const email = `${userId.toLowerCase()}@bxb-team.com`;
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });

    if (error) {
      toast.error('Invalid User ID or Password');
      setLoading(false);
    } else {
      toast.success('Welcome back');
    }
  }

  async function handleClaim(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!userId || !password || !username) return;
    setLoading(true);

    const email = `${userId.toLowerCase()}@bxb-team.com`;

    const { data: authData, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password });
    if (authError || !authData.user) {
      toast.error(authError?.message || 'Could not create account');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    let avatarUrl = null;
    if (avatar) {
      const ext = avatar.name.split('.').pop();
      const path = `${authData.user.id}/avatar.${ext}`;
      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, avatar, { upsert: true });
      if (!uploadError) {
        const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
        avatarUrl = urlData.publicUrl;
      }
    }

    const { error: claimError } = await supabase.rpc('claim_user_id', {
      p_user_id_code: userId.toUpperCase(),
      p_username: username,
      p_avatar_url: avatarUrl
    });

    if (claimError) {
      toast.error(claimError.message);
      setLoading(false);
    } else {
      toast.success('Account claimed successfully');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-dvh flex flex-col bg-[var(--bg-base)] relative overflow-hidden">

      {/* Subtle background gradient */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none" style={{
        background: theme === 'dark'
          ? 'radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(255,107,44,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%)'
          : 'radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(255,107,44,0.05) 0%, transparent 60%)'
      }} />

      {/* Theme Toggle */}
      <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-50">
        <button
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-[var(--bg-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors border border-[var(--border)] backdrop-blur-md"
          aria-label="Toggle theme"
        >
          {theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={18} /> : <Moon size={18} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 w-full max-w-md mx-auto animate-enter relative z-10">

        {/* Logo & Branding */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center mb-8">
          <div className="relative mb-5 group">
            {/* Logo Glow */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[var(--brand)] blur-2xl opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-40 transition-opacity duration-500 rounded-full" />

            {/* Logo Container */}
            <div className="w-20 h-20 flex items-center justify-center relative z-10">
              <img
                src="/logo.webp"
                alt="BXB Logo"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain drop-shadow-2xl"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.display = 'none';
                  e.currentTarget.parentElement!.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--brand);font-weight:bold;font-size:24px;">BXB</span>';
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-[26px] font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)]">BXB Teams</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1.5 text-center leading-tight italic opacity-80">
            On my stallion i will ride with the 4 horsemen
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Auth Card */}
        <div className="w-full card !p-7 md:!p-8 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[var(--bg-surface)]/95 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h2 className="text-[20px] font-bold tracking-tight mb-1">
              {mode === 'login' ? 'Welcome back' : 'Claim your Team ID'}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[13px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
              {mode === 'login'
                ? 'Sign in to continue to your workspace.'
                : 'Enter your assigned ID to join the network.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Auto-complete completely disabled on form and inputs */}
          <form onSubmit={mode === 'login' ? handleLogin : handleClaim} className="space-y-4" autoComplete="off">

            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">User ID</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={userId}
                onChange={e => setUserId(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                className="input-field font-mono uppercase !bg-[var(--bg-base)]"
                autoComplete="off"
                name="user_id_no_autofill"
                placeholder=""
                required
              />
            </div>

            {mode === 'claim' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Username</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={username}
                    onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                    className="input-field !bg-[var(--bg-base)]"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    name="username_no_autofill"
                    placeholder=""
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Profile photo (optional)</label>
                  <label
                    htmlFor="avatar-upload"
                    className="flex items-center justify-between w-full h-[46px] px-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-base)] hover:border-[#FF6B2C]/50 cursor-pointer transition-colors group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 truncate">
                      <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors ${avatar ? 'bg-[#FF6B2C]/20 text-[#FF6B2C]' : 'bg-[var(--bg-subtle)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] group-hover:text-[#FF6B2C]'}`}>
                        <Camera size={14} />
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-[13px] truncate ${avatar ? 'text-white font-medium' : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}`}>
                        {avatar ? avatar.name : 'Choose a profile photo...'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {avatar ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          setAvatar(null);
                          const fileInput = document.getElementById('avatar-upload') as HTMLInputElement;
                          if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
                        }}
                        className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 shrink-0 ml-2 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors bg-red-400/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-md"
                      >
                        <X size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
                        Remove
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#FF6B2C] shrink-0 ml-2 group-hover:text-[#FF6B2C]/80 transition-colors bg-[#FF6B2C]/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md">
                        Browse
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="avatar-upload"
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    onChange={e => setAvatar(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Password</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                value={password}
                onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field !bg-[var(--bg-base)]"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                name="password_no_autofill"
                placeholder=""
                required
              />
            </div>

            <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-primary w-full mt-2 !h-[46px] text-[15px] shadow-lg shadow-brand-primary/20">
              {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={18} /> : (
                <>
                  {mode === 'login' ? 'Log In' : 'Create Account'}
                  <ArrowRight size={18} />
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-[var(--border)] text-center">
            <button
              onClick={() => setMode(mode === 'login' ? 'claim' : 'login')}
              className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-[var(--brand)] hover:text-[var(--brand-hover)] transition-colors py-1"
            >
              {mode === 'login' ? "New here? Claim your User ID" : "Already have an account? Sign in"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {!isInstalled && <PWAInstallButton onClick={promptInstall} />}

        <p className="mt-8 text-[12px] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">
          We will all win at the end
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { localToday } from '../lib/date';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Plus, Calendar, Clock, MapPin, Video, CheckCircle2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox, SkeletonCard } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Meeting = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  meeting_type: string | null;
  meeting_date: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string | null;
  timezone: string;
  meeting_link: string | null;
  location: string | null;
  status: string;
  notes: string | null;
  outcome: string | null;
  assigned_to: string;
};

const TERMINAL_STATUSES = ['Completed', 'Cancelled', 'No Show'];

function statusBadgeClass(s: string) {
  if (s === 'Confirmed' || s === 'Completed') return 'badge-success';
  if (s === 'Cancelled' || s === 'No Show') return 'badge-danger';
  if (s === 'Awaiting Confirmation') return 'badge-warning';
  if (s === 'Rescheduled') return 'badge-neutral';
  return 'badge-info';
}

export default function Meetings() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const routerLocation = useLocation();
  const [meetings, setMeetings] = useState<Meeting[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showSheet, setShowSheet] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [updatingId, setUpdatingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'upcoming' | 'past'>('upcoming');

  const [leadId, setLeadId] = useState('');
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<{ id: string; name: string }[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [meetingType, setMeetingType] = useState('Discovery');
  const [meetingDate, setMeetingDate] = useState('');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState('');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState('');
  const [link, setLink] = useState('');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMeetings();
    async function fetchLeadsList() {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('leads').select('id, businesses(name)');
      if (data) setLeads(data.map((l: any) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.businesses?.name || 'Unnamed' })));
    }
    fetchLeadsList();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const state = (routerLocation.state as any) || {};
    if (state.openCreate) {
      setShowSheet(true);
      if (state.leadId) setLeadId(state.leadId);
    }
  }, [routerLocation.state]);

  async function fetchMeetings() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('meetings')
      .select('id, title, meeting_type, meeting_date, start_time, end_time, timezone, meeting_link, location, status, notes, outcome, assigned_to')
      .order('meeting_date', { ascending: false });
    if (data) setMeetings(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile || !title || !meetingDate || !startTime) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('meetings').insert({
      lead_id: leadId || null,
      title,
      meeting_type: meetingType || null,
      meeting_date: meetingDate,
      start_time: startTime,
      end_time: endTime || null,
      timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
      meeting_link: link || null,
      location: location || null,
      status: 'Proposed',
      notes: notes || null,
      created_by: profile.id,
      assigned_to: profile.id,
    });
    if (!error) {
      toast.success('Meeting scheduled');
      setLeadId(''); setTitle(''); setMeetingType('Discovery'); setMeetingDate(''); setStartTime('');
      setEndTime(''); setLink(''); setLocation(''); setNotes('');
      setShowSheet(false);
      fetchMeetings();
    } else {
      toast.error('Could not schedule meeting');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function updateStatus(id: string, status: string) {
    setUpdatingId(id);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('meetings').update({ status }).eq('id', id);
    if (!error) {
      toast.success(
        status === 'Confirmed' ? 'Meeting confirmed'
          : status === 'Completed' ? 'Meeting completed'
          : status === 'Cancelled' ? 'Meeting cancelled'
          : 'Meeting updated'
      );
      await fetchMeetings();
    } else {
      toast.error('Failed to update meeting');
    }
    setUpdatingId(null);
  }

  const today = localToday();
  const filtered = meetings.filter(m => tab === 'upcoming' ? m.meeting_date >= today : m.meeting_date < today);
  const upcomingCount = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date >= today).length;
  const pastCount = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date < today).length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-28 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-9 w-24 rounded-xl" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map(i => <SkeletonCard key={i} />)}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Meetings</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {upcomingCount} upcoming · {pastCount} past
          </p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => setShowSheet(true)} className="btn-primary shrink-0">
          <Plus size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} /> New Meeting
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('upcoming')}
          className={tab === 'upcoming' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}
        >
          Upcoming
          <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{upcomingCount}</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('past')}
          className={tab === 'past' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}
        >
          Past
          <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{pastCount}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <Calendar size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">No {tab} meetings</h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
            {tab === 'upcoming'
              ? 'Schedule a meeting with a prospect to see it here.'
              : 'Completed meetings will appear here.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(m => {
            const canAct = !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(m.status);
            const dateLabel = new Date(m.meeting_date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
              weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
            });
            const timeLabel = m.start_time.slice(0, 5) + (m.end_time ? '–' + m.end_time.slice(0, 5) : '');
            return (
              <div key={m.id} className="card p-3.5 md:p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug truncate">{m.title}</h3>
                    {m.meeting_type && (
                      <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark truncate">
                        {m.meeting_type}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span className={statusBadgeClass(m.status) + ' shrink-0'}>{m.status}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <Calendar size={13} className="shrink-0" /> {dateLabel}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <Clock size={13} className="shrink-0" /> {timeLabel}
                  </span>
                  {m.location && (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                      <MapPin size={13} className="shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{m.location}</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {m.meeting_link && (
                  <a
                    href={m.meeting_link}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 mt-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-brand-primary hover:text-brand-primaryHover"
                  >
                    <Video size={13} /> Join meeting
                  </a>
                )}

                {canAct && (
                  <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => updateStatus(m.id, 'Confirmed')}
                      disabled={updatingId === m.id}
                      className="flex-1 h-[38px] rounded-lg bg-state-successSoft text-state-success text-[12px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {updatingId === m.id ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <><CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Confirm</>}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => updateStatus(m.id, 'Completed')}
                      disabled={updatingId === m.id}
                      className="flex-1 h-[38px] rounded-lg bg-brand-primary text-black text-[12px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {updatingId === m.id ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <><CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Complete</>}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => updateStatus(m.id, 'Cancelled')}
                      disabled={updatingId === m.id}
                      className="flex-1 h-[38px] rounded-lg bg-state-dangerSoft text-state-danger text-[12px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {updatingId === m.id ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <><X size={14} /> Cancel</>}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={showSheet}
        onClose={() => setShowSheet(false)}
        title="New Meeting"
        footer={
          <button type="submit" form="new-meeting-form" disabled={saving} className="btn-primary w-full">
            {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={18} /> : 'Save Meeting'}
          </button>
        }
      >
        <form id="new-meeting-form" onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Link to Lead</label>
            <select value={leadId} onChange={e => setLeadId(e.target.value)} className="input-field">
              <option value="">None</option>
              {leads.map(l => <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Title *</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={title}
              onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              className="input-field"
              placeholder="e.g. Discovery call with ABC"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Type</label>
            <select value={meetingType} onChange={e => setMeetingType(e.target.value)} className="input-field">
              <option value="Discovery">Discovery</option>
              <option value="Follow-up">Follow-up</option>
              <option value="Proposal Discussion">Proposal Discussion</option>
              <option value="Internal">Internal</option>
              <option value="Other">Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Date *</label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={meetingDate}
              onChange={e => setMeetingDate(e.target.value)}
              className="input-field"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Start *</label>
              <input type="time" value={startTime} onChange={e => setStartTime(e.target.value)} className="input-field" required />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">End</label>
              <input type="time" value={endTime} onChange={e => setEndTime(e.target.value)} className="input-field" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Meeting link</label>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={link}
              onChange={e => setLink(e.target.value)}
              className="input-field"
              placeholder="https://zoom.us/j/…"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Location</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={location}
              onChange={e => setLocation(e.target.value)}
              className="input-field"
              placeholder="Office, address…"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Notes</label>
            <textarea

              className="input-field"
              placeholder="Optional agenda"
              rows={2}
            />
          </div>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Bell, CheckCircle2, Info, AlertTriangle, XCircle, CheckCheck, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Notification = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  body: string | null;
  link: string | null;
  type: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  created_at: string;
};

const ICONS: Record<string, any> = {
  info: Info,
  success: CheckCircle2,
  warning: AlertTriangle,
  error: XCircle,
};

const TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  info: 'text-state-info bg-state-infoSoft',
  success: 'text-state-success bg-state-successSoft',
  warning: 'text-state-warning bg-state-warningSoft',
  error: 'text-state-danger bg-state-dangerSoft',
};

type Tab = 'all' | 'unread';

export default function Notifications() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('all');
  const [markingAll, setMarkingAll] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { fetchNotifications(); }, []);

  async function fetchNotifications() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .select('id, title, body, link, type, is_read, created_at')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(100);
    if (data) setNotifications(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }


  async function markAllRead() {
    if (!profile || markingAll) return;
    setMarkingAll(true);
    const previous = notifications;
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, is_read: true })));
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .update({ is_read: true })
      .eq('user_id', profile.id)
      .eq('is_read', false);
    if (error) {
      setNotifications(previous);
      toast.error('Failed to mark all as read');
    } else {
      toast.success('All notifications marked as read');
    }
    setMarkingAll(false);
  }

  function openNotification(n: Notification) {
    if (!n.is_read) {
      // Optimistic flip + silent fire-and-forget — we are navigating away,
      // so a failure toast here would just confuse the destination page.
      setNotifications(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === n.id ? { ...x, is_read: true } : x));
      supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true }).eq('id', n.id);
    }
    if (n.link) navigate(n.link);
  }

  const filtered = tab === 'unread' ? notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read) : notifications;
  const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;
  const readCount = notifications.length - unreadCount;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32 mb-2" />
        <SkeletonBox className="h-3 w-40 mb-5" />
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-9 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="card p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
              <SkeletonBox className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl shrink-0" />
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                <SkeletonBox className="h-4 w-2/3" />
                <SkeletonBox className="h-3 w-1/2" />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Notifications</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {unreadCount} unread · {readCount} read
          </p>
        </div>
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={markAllRead}
            disabled={markingAll}
            className="btn-secondary shrink-0 !h-[38px] !text-[12px]"
          >
            {markingAll ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <><CheckCheck size={14} /> Mark all read</>}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        <button onClick={() => setTab('all')} className={tab === 'all' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
          All
          {notifications.length > 0 && (
            <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{notifications.length}</span>
          )}
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => setTab('unread')} className={tab === 'unread' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
          Unread
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{unreadCount}</span>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <Bell size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">
            {tab === 'unread' ? 'Nothing unread' : 'No notifications yet'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
            {tab === 'unread'
              ? 'You are all caught up.'
              : 'Alerts about leads, meetings and approvals will appear here.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(n => {
            const Icon = ICONS[n.type] || Info;
            const tone = TONE[n.type] || TONE.info;
            return (
              <button
                key={n.id}
                onClick={() => openNotification(n)}
                className="card p-3 w-full text-left flex items-start gap-3 hover:border-brand-primary/30 transition-colors active:scale-[0.995]"
              >
                <div className={'w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ' + tone}>
                  <Icon size={16} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-0.5">
                    <p className={'text-[13px] leading-snug flex-1 min-w-0 ' + (n.is_read ? 'font-medium' : 'font-semibold')}>
                      {n.title}
                    </p>
                    {!n.is_read && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-brand-primary shrink-0 mt-1.5" />}
                  </div>
                  {n.body && (
                    <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark line-clamp-2 mb-1">
                      {n.body}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark">

          {notifications.length >= 100 && (
            <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark text-center pt-2">
              Showing 100 most recent notifications
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { localToday } from '../lib/date';
import { LEAD_STAGES, INACTIVE_STAGES, stageBadgeClass } from '../lib/stages';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Search, Layers, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox, SkeletonCard } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Lead = {
  id: string;
  business_id: string;
  stage: string;
  priority: string | null;
  next_follow_up: string | null;
  assigned_to: string | null;
  businesses: { name: string; industry: string | null; city: string | null } | null;
};

function StageColumn({ stage, leads, onOpen }: { stage: string; leads: Lead[]; onOpen: (lead: Lead) => void }) {
  const today = localToday();
  return (
    <div className="shrink-0 w-full md:w-[300px]">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 px-1">
        <span className={stageBadgeClass(stage)}>{stage}</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold font-mono tabular-nums text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark">
          {leads.length}
        </span>
      </div>
      {leads.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark px-4 py-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-[12px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark">No leads</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {leads.map(lead => (
            <button
              key={lead.id}
              onClick={() => onOpen(lead)}
              className="card p-3 w-full text-left hover:border-brand-primary/30 active:scale-[0.995] transition-all"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 mb-2">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Building2 size={15} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold tracking-tight truncate">{lead.businesses?.name || 'Unnamed'}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark truncate">
                    {[lead.businesses?.industry, lead.businesses?.city].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'No details'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {((lead.priority && lead.priority !== 'Medium') || lead.next_follow_up) && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {lead.priority && lead.priority !== 'Medium' && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
                      {lead.priority}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {lead.next_follow_up && (
                    <span className={'text-[10px] font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md ' + (lead.next_follow_up < today ? 'bg-state-dangerSoft text-state-danger' : 'bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark')}>
                      {new Date(lead.next_follow_up).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type Filter = 'active' | 'all' | 'mine' | 'overdue' | 'unassigned';

export default function Pipeline() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('active');
  const [activeStage, setActiveStage] = useState<string>('New Lead');
  const [selectedLead, setSelectedLead] = useState<Lead | null>(null);
  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);

  const mobileBoardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { fetchLeads(); }, []);

  async function fetchLeads() {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('leads')
      .select('id, business_id, stage, priority, next_follow_up, assigned_to, businesses(name, industry, city)')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (!error && data) setLeads(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleUpdateStage(newStage: string) {
    if (!selectedLead) return;
    setIsUpdating(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('leads').update({ stage: newStage }).eq('id', selectedLead.id).select();
    if (error) {
      console.error('Update stage error:', error);
      toast.error('Error: ' + (error.message || error.details || 'Unknown error'));
    } else if (!data || data.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Update failed: Lead not found or permission denied.');
    } else {
      toast.success('Stage updated');
      setSelectedLead({ ...selectedLead, stage: newStage });
      fetchLeads();
    }
    setIsUpdating(false);
  }

  const today = localToday();

  const filtered = leads.filter(l => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !searchQuery ||
      (l.businesses?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (l.businesses?.industry || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (l.businesses?.city || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;

    switch (filter) {
      case 'active': return !INACTIVE_STAGES.includes(l.stage);
      case 'mine': return l.assigned_to === profile?.id;
      case 'overdue': return !!l.next_follow_up && l.next_follow_up < today && !INACTIVE_STAGES.includes(l.stage);
      case 'unassigned': return !l.assigned_to;
      default: return true;
    }
  });

  const visibleLEAD_STAGES = filter === 'active'
    ? LEAD_STAGES.filter(s => !INACTIVE_STAGES.includes(s))
    : LEAD_STAGES;

  const grouped: Record<string, Lead[]> = {};
  visibleLEAD_STAGES.forEach(s => { grouped[s] = []; });
  filtered.forEach(l => {
    if (grouped[l.stage]) grouped[l.stage].push(l);
  });

  // Auto-select first non-empty stage on initial load
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) return;
    const firstNonEmpty = visibleLEAD_STAGES.find(s => (grouped[s]?.length || 0) > 0);
    if (firstNonEmpty) setActiveStage(firstNonEmpty);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [loading]);

  // Reset active stage when it disappears from visible LEAD_STAGES (filter change)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visibleLEAD_STAGES.includes(activeStage)) {
      setActiveStage(visibleLEAD_STAGES[0] || 'New Lead');
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [filter]);

  function jumpToStage(stage: string) {
    setActiveStage(stage);
    const container = mobileBoardRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const el = container.querySelector('[data-stage="' + stage + '"]') as HTMLElement | null;
    if (el) {
      container.scrollTo({ left: el.offsetLeft - 24, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }

  function handleMobileScroll() {
    if (scrollTimer.current) clearTimeout(scrollTimer.current);
    scrollTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      const container = mobileBoardRef.current;
      if (!container) return;
      const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const containerCenter = containerRect.left + containerRect.width / 2;
      const columns = container.querySelectorAll('[data-stage]');
      let bestStage = activeStage;
      let bestDist = Infinity;
      columns.forEach(col => {
        const rect = col.getBoundingClientRect();
        const center = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
        const dist = Math.abs(center - containerCenter);
        if (dist < bestDist) {
          bestDist = dist;
          bestStage = (col as HTMLElement).dataset.stage || activeStage;
        }
      });
      if (bestStage !== activeStage) setActiveStage(bestStage);
    }, 100);
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-full mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-10 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl mb-3" />
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-4">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-8 w-20 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-hidden">
          {[0, 1].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="shrink-0 w-[85vw] max-w-[340px] sm:w-[300px] space-y-2">
              <SkeletonBox className="h-6 w-24" />
              <SkeletonCard />
              <SkeletonCard />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-full mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Pipeline</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {leads.filter(l => !INACTIVE_STAGES.includes(l.stage)).length} active · {leads.length} total
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" size={18} />
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Search leads..."
          className="input-field !pl-10"
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-4 scrollbar-hide">
        {([
          { key: 'active', label: 'Active' },
          { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
          { key: 'mine', label: 'Mine' },
          { key: 'overdue', label: 'Overdue' },
          { key: 'unassigned', label: 'Unassigned' },
        ] as { key: Filter; label: string }[]).map(f => (
          <button key={f.key} onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)} className={filter === f.key ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <Layers size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">
            {searchQuery ? 'No matching leads' : filter !== 'all' ? 'Nothing in this view' : 'No leads yet'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[280px] mx-auto">
            {searchQuery
              ? 'Try a different search term.'
              : filter !== 'all'
                ? 'Switch to "All" to see more LEAD_STAGES.'
                : 'Create your first lead from the Leads page.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Desktop kanban */}
          <div className="hidden md:flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-4">
            {visibleLEAD_STAGES.map(stage => (
              <StageColumn key={stage} stage={stage} leads={grouped[stage] || []} onOpen={(l) => setSelectedLead(l)} />
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Mobile: stage picker + snap board */}
          <div className="md:hidden">
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-3 scrollbar-hide">
              {visibleLEAD_STAGES.map(stage => (
                <button
                  key={stage}
                  onClick={() => jumpToStage(stage)}
                  className={activeStage === stage ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}
                >
                  {stage}
                  <span className="ml-1 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">
                    {grouped[stage]?.length || 0}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div
              ref={mobileBoardRef}
              onScroll={handleMobileScroll}
              className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory pb-4 -mx-6 px-6"
            >
              {visibleLEAD_STAGES.map(stage => (
                <div key={stage} data-stage={stage} className="snap-center shrink-0 w-[85vw] max-w-[340px]">
                  <StageColumn stage={stage} leads={grouped[stage] || []} onOpen={(l) => setSelectedLead(l)} />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={!!selectedLead}
        onClose={() => setSelectedLead(null)}
        title={selectedLead?.businesses?.name || 'Lead'}
      >
        {selectedLead && (
          <div className="space-y-4">

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Playbook | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';

  useEffect(() => { fetchPlaybooks(); }, []);

  async function fetchPlaybooks() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('sales_playbooks')
      .select('*')
      .order('is_universal', { ascending: false })
      .order('name', { ascending: true });
    if (data) setPlaybooks(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  function openAdd() { setEditing(null); setForm(EMPTY_FORM); setShowForm(true); }
  function openEdit(p: Playbook) {
    setEditing(p);
    setForm({
      name: p.name,
      country: p.country || '',
      language: p.language || 'English',
      target_industries: p.target_industries || '',
      prospecting_strategies: p.prospecting_strategies || '',
      communication_guidance: p.communication_guidance || '',
      calling_scripts: p.calling_scripts || '',
      email_templates: p.email_templates || '',
      messaging_templates: p.messaging_templates || '',
      discovery_questions: p.discovery_questions || '',
      common_objections: p.common_objections || '',
      market_examples: p.market_examples || '',
      compliance_guidance: p.compliance_guidance || '',
      is_universal: p.is_universal,
      is_active: p.is_active,
    });
    setShowForm(true);
    setSelected(null);
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile || !form.name.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      country: form.country.trim() || null,
      language: form.language.trim() || 'English',
      target_industries: form.target_industries.trim() || null,
      prospecting_strategies: form.prospecting_strategies.trim() || null,
      communication_guidance: form.communication_guidance.trim() || null,
      calling_scripts: form.calling_scripts.trim() || null,
      email_templates: form.email_templates.trim() || null,
      messaging_templates: form.messaging_templates.trim() || null,
      discovery_questions: form.discovery_questions.trim() || null,
      common_objections: form.common_objections.trim() || null,
      market_examples: form.market_examples.trim() || null,
      compliance_guidance: form.compliance_guidance.trim() || null,
      is_universal: form.is_universal,
      is_active: form.is_active,
      created_by: profile.id,
    };
    const { error } = editing
      ? await supabase.from('sales_playbooks').update(payload).eq('id', editing.id)
      : await supabase.from('sales_playbooks').insert(payload);
    if (!error) {
      toast.success(editing ? 'Playbook updated' : 'Playbook created');
      setShowForm(false); setEditing(null);
      fetchPlaybooks();
    } else {
      toast.error(editing ? 'Could not update playbook' : 'Could not create playbook');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  const filtered = playbooks.filter(p => {
    if (!isAdmin && !p.is_active) return false;
    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      if (!p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !(p.country || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) && !(p.target_industries || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl mb-5" />
        <div className="space-y-2">

        </div>
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">

      <div className="relative mb-4">

            <BookOpen size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">{search ? 'No matching playbooks' : 'No playbooks yet'}</h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">

      ) : (

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Camera, LogOut, Save, Hash, User, Shield, Laptop, Smartphone } from 'lucide-react';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { PWAInstallButton } from '../components/PWAInstallButton';
import { usePWAInstall } from '../hooks/usePWAInstall';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

export default function Profile() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isInstalled, promptInstall } = usePWAInstall();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState('');
  const [countryName, setCountryName] = useState('');
  const [points, setPoints] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    setUsername(profile.username || '');
    setAvatarUrl(profile.avatar_url || null);
    fetchTeam();
  }, [profile]);

  async function fetchTeam() {
    if (!profile) return;
    setLoading(true);
    const { data: team } = await supabase
      .from('teams')
      .select('name, country_id, countries(name)')
      .eq('id', profile.team_id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (team) {
      setTeamName((team as any).name || '');
      setCountryName((team as any).countries?.name || '');
    }
    setPoints((profile as any).points || 0);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleSave(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ username: username.trim() })
      .eq('id', profile.id);
    if (error) {
      toast.error('Could not save profile');
      setSaving(false);
    } else {
      toast.success('Profile updated');
      // Reload so the sidebar/header re-hydrates from Supabase
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 400);
    }
  }

  async function handleAvatarUpload(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !profile) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      toast.error('Only images allowed');
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error('Avatar must be under 5 MB');
      return;
    }
    setUploading(true);
    const ext = file.name.split('.').pop() || 'png';
    const path = profile.id + '/avatar-' + Date.now() + '.' + ext;
    const up = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, file, { upsert: true });
    if (up.error) {
      toast.error('Upload failed');
      setUploading(false);
      return;
    }
    const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update({ avatar_url: urlData.publicUrl }).eq('id', profile.id);
    if (error) {
      toast.error('Could not save avatar');
      setUploading(false);
    } else {
      toast.success('Avatar updated');
      setAvatarUrl(urlData.publicUrl);
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 400);
    }
  }

  async function handleSignOut() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    navigate('/login');
  }

  if (!profile) return null;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32 mb-5" />
        <div className="card p-4 mb-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <SkeletonBox className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full" />
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
            <SkeletonBox className="h-5 w-40" />
            <SkeletonBox className="h-3 w-32" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-40 rounded-2xl mb-4" />
        <SkeletonBox className="h-12 rounded-2xl" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-2xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="mb-5 md:mb-6">
        <h1 className="page-title">Profile</h1>
        <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
          Your account details and avatar
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="card !p-4 mb-4 flex items-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative shrink-0">
          <img
            src={avatarUrl || 'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/bottts/svg?seed=' + profile.username}
            alt=""
            className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5"
          />
          <label className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-brand-primary text-black flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform">
            {uploading ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Camera size={14} />}
            <input
              type="file"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp"
              onChange={handleAvatarUpload}
              className="hidden"
              disabled={uploading}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <h2 className="text-[18px] font-bold tracking-tight truncate">{profile.username}</h2>
          <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark font-mono tabular-nums">{profile.user_id_code}</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
            <span className={profile.role === 'admin' ? 'badge-brand' : 'badge-neutral'}>{profile.role}</span>
            {teamName && <span className="badge-neutral">{teamName}</span>}
            {countryName && <span className="badge-neutral">{countryName}</span>}
            {points > 0 && <span className="badge-success">{points} pts</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="card !p-4 mb-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Username</label>
          <div className="relative">
            <User size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={username}
              onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              className="input-field pl-10"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">User ID</label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Hash size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" />
            <input type="text" value={profile.user_id_code} className="input-field pl-10 font-mono bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5" readOnly />
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mt-1">Contact your admin to change this.</p>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Role</label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Shield size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" />
            <input type="text" value={profile.role} className="input-field pl-10 capitalize bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5" readOnly />
          </div>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="btn-primary w-full">
          {saving ? <><Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> Saving…</> : <><Save size={16} /> Save Changes</>}
        </button>
      </form>

      {!isInstalled && (
        <div className="card !p-6 mb-4 flex flex-col items-center text-center bg-gradient-to-b from-[var(--bg-surface)] to-[var(--bg-base)] border border-[var(--border)]">
          <div className="relative w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FF6B2C]/20 to-[#FF6B2C]/5 ring-1 ring-[#FF6B2C]/20 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] flex items-center justify-center mb-4 text-[#FF6B2C]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Laptop size={20} strokeWidth={2} />
                <Smartphone size={20} strokeWidth={2} />
              </div>
            </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold tracking-tight mb-1">Get the BXB Teams App</h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark mb-4 max-w-[250px]">
            Install BXB Teams on your phone or laptop for quick access and a native, full-screen experience.
          </p>
          <PWAInstallButton onClick={promptInstall} />
        </div>
      )}

      <button onClick={handleSignOut} className="w-full h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-state-dangerSoft text-state-danger text-[13px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform">
        <LogOut size={16} /> Sign out
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
