```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Plus, FileText, ChevronRight, CheckCircle2, X, Clock, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Proposal = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  version: number;
  approval_status: string;
  pricing: number | null;
  currency: string | null;
  expiration_date: string | null;
  service_description: string | null;
  proposed_solution: string | null;
  scope_of_work: string | null;
  deliverables: string | null;
  exclusions: string | null;
  estimated_timeline: string | null;
  payment_milestones: string | null;
  maintenance_arrangements: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  created_by: string;
  assigned_to: string | null;
};

const CURRENCIES = ['USD', 'EUR', 'TND', 'GBP'];

function statusBadgeClass(s: string) {
  if (s === 'Approved') return 'badge-success';
  if (s === 'Rejected') return 'badge-danger';
  if (s === 'Pending Approval') return 'badge-warning';
  if (s === 'Sent') return 'badge-info';
  if (s === 'Expired') return 'badge-neutral';
  return 'badge-neutral';
}

type Filter = 'all' | 'draft' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'sent';

export default function Proposals() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState<Proposal[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showSheet, setShowSheet] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Proposal | null>(null);
  const [updatingAction, setUpdatingAction] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all');

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [serviceDescription, setServiceDescription] = useState('');
  const [proposedSolution, setProposedSolution] = useState('');
  const [scope, setScope] = useState('');
  const [deliverables, setDeliverables] = useState('');
  const [exclusions, setExclusions] = useState('');
  const [timeline, setTimeline] = useState('');
  const [pricing, setPricing] = useState('');
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState('USD');
  const [milestones, setMilestones] = useState('');
  const [maintenance, setMaintenance] = useState('');
  const [expiration, setExpiration] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { fetchProposals(); }, []);

  async function fetchProposals() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('proposals')
      .select('id, title, version, approval_status, pricing, currency, expiration_date, service_description, proposed_solution, scope_of_work, deliverables, exclusions, estimated_timeline, payment_milestones, maintenance_arrangements, created_at, created_by, assigned_to')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (data) setProposals(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile || !title) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('proposals').insert({
      title,
      service_description: serviceDescription || null,
      proposed_solution: proposedSolution || null,
      scope_of_work: scope || null,
      deliverables: deliverables || null,
      exclusions: exclusions || null,
      estimated_timeline: timeline || null,
      pricing: pricing ? parseFloat(pricing) : null,
      currency,
      payment_milestones: milestones || null,
      maintenance_arrangements: maintenance || null,
      expiration_date: expiration || null,
      approval_status: 'Draft',
      version: 1,
      created_by: profile.id,
      assigned_to: profile.id,
    });
    if (!error) {
      toast.success('Proposal created');
      setTitle(''); setServiceDescription(''); setProposedSolution(''); setScope('');
      setDeliverables(''); setExclusions(''); setTimeline(''); setPricing('');
      setCurrency('USD'); setMilestones(''); setMaintenance(''); setExpiration('');
      setShowSheet(false);
      fetchProposals();
    } else {
      toast.error('Could not create proposal');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

      async function requestApproval(p: Proposal) {
    if (!profile) return;
    setUpdatingAction('request:' + p.id);
    const { error: approvalError } = await supabase.from('proposal_approvals').insert({
      proposal_id: p.id,
      requested_by: profile.id,
      decision: 'Pending',
    });
    if (approvalError) {
      toast.error('Could not request approval');
      setUpdatingAction(null);
      return;
    }
    const { error } = await supabase.from('proposals').update({ approval_status: 'Pending Approval' }).eq('id', p.id);
    if (!error) {
      toast.success('Approval requested');
      await fetchProposals();
      if (selected) setSelected({ ...selected, approval_status: 'Pending Approval' });
    } else {
      toast.error('Failed to request approval');
    }
    setUpdatingAction(null);
  }

  async function decideApproval(p: Proposal, decision: 'Approved' | 'Rejected') {
    if (!profile) return;
    const key = (decision === 'Approved' ? 'approve:' : 'reject:') + p.id;
    setUpdatingAction(key);
    
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('decide_proposal_approval', { p_proposal_id: p.id, p_decision: decision });
    
    if (!error) {
      toast.success(decision === 'Approved' ? 'Proposal approved' : 'Proposal rejected');
      await fetchProposals();
      if (selected) setSelected({ ...selected, approval_status: decision });
    } else {
      toast.error('Failed to update proposal');
    }
    setUpdatingAction(null);
  }

  function formatValue(value: number | null, cur: string | null) {
    if (!value) return null;
    return (cur || 'USD') + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }

  const counts = {
    all: proposals.length,
    draft: proposals.filter(p => p.approval_status === 'Draft').length,
    pending: proposals.filter(p => p.approval_status === 'Pending Approval').length,
    approved: proposals.filter(p => p.approval_status === 'Approved').length,
    sent: proposals.filter(p => p.approval_status === 'Sent').length,
  };

  const filtered = proposals.filter(p => {
    if (filter === 'draft') return p.approval_status === 'Draft';
    if (filter === 'pending') return p.approval_status === 'Pending Approval';
    if (filter === 'approved') return p.approval_status === 'Approved';
    if (filter === 'sent') return p.approval_status === 'Sent';
    return true;
  });

  const approvedValue = proposals
    .filter(p => p.approval_status === 'Approved' || p.approval_status === 'Sent')
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.pricing || 0), 0);
  const approvedCount = proposals.filter(
    p => (p.approval_status === 'Approved' || p.approval_status === 'Sent') && p.pricing
  ).length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-32 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="card p-3.5">
              <SkeletonBox className="h-4 w-2/3 mb-2" />
              <SkeletonBox className="h-3 w-1/3" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Proposals</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {counts.pending} pending · {counts.approved} approved
          </p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => setShowSheet(true)} className="btn-primary shrink-0">
          <Plus size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} /> New Proposal
        </button>
      </div>

      {approvedValue > 0 && (
        <div className="card mb-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <DollarSign size={13} className="text-brand-primary shrink-0" />
            <span className="eyebrow">Approved value</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[24px] font-bold font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tighter leading-none">
            {approvedValue.toLocaleString()}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mt-1">
            Across {approvedCount} approved or sent proposal{approvedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} with pricing
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        {([
          { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
          { key: 'draft', label: 'Draft' },
          { key: 'pending', label: 'Pending' },
          { key: 'approved', label: 'Approved' },
          { key: 'sent', label: 'Sent' },
        ] as { key: Filter; label: string }[]).map(f => (
          <button key={f.key} onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)} className={filter === f.key ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
            {f.label}
            {counts[f.key] > 0 && (
              <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{counts[f.key]}</span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <FileText size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">
            {filter === 'all' ? 'No proposals yet' : 'Nothing here'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
            {filter === 'all'
              ? 'Create a proposal to send to a prospect.'
              : 'Switch to "All" to see the full list.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(p => {
            const valueLabel = formatValue(p.pricing, p.currency);
            return (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                onClick={() => setSelected(p)}
                className="card p-3.5 md:p-4 w-full text-left hover:border-brand-primary/30 active:scale-[0.995] transition-all"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <FileText size={18} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-1">
                      <h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug flex-1 min-w-0 truncate">
                        {p.title}
                      </h3>
                      <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[12px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mb-1.5">
                      v{p.version}{valueLabel ? ' · ' + valueLabel : ''}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className={statusBadgeClass(p.approval_status)}>{p.approval_status}</span>
                      {p.expiration_date && (
                        <span className="badge-neutral">
                          Exp {new Date(p.expiration_date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title={selected?.title || 'Proposal'}
      >
        {selected && (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              <span className={statusBadgeClass(selected.approval_status)}>{selected.approval_status}</span>
              <span className="badge-neutral">v{selected.version}</span>
              {selected.expiration_date && (
                <span className="badge-neutral">
                  Exp {new Date(selected.expiration_date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {selected.approval_status === 'Draft' && (
              <button
                onClick={() => requestApproval(selected)}
                disabled={!!updatingAction}
                className="btn-primary w-full"
              >
                {updatingAction === 'request:' + selected.id
                  ? <><Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> Requesting…</>
                  : 'Request approval'}
              </button>
            )}

            {isAdmin && selected.approval_status === 'Pending Approval' && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => decideApproval(selected, 'Approved')}
                  disabled={!!updatingAction}
                  className="flex-1 h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-state-successSoft text-state-success font-semibold text-[13px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {updatingAction === 'approve:' + selected.id
                    ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                    : <><CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Approve</>}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => decideApproval(selected, 'Rejected')}
                  disabled={!!updatingAction}
                  className="flex-1 h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-state-dangerSoft text-state-danger font-semibold text-[13px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {updatingAction === 'reject:' + selected.id
                    ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                    : <><X size={14} /> Reject</>}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {selected.pricing && (
              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Pricing</p>
                <div className="card !p-3">
                  <p className="text-[22px] font-bold font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tight text-brand-primary leading-none">
                    {selected.currency || 'USD'} {selected.pricing.toLocaleString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selected.service_description && (
              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Service</p>
                <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.service_description}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selected.proposed_solution && (
              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Proposed solution</p>
                <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.proposed_solution}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selected.scope_of_work && (
              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Scope of work</p>
                <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.scope_of_work}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            {(selected.deliverables || selected.exclusions) && (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {selected.deliverables && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Deliverables</p>
                    <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.deliverables}</div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {selected.exclusions && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Exclusions</p>
                    <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.exclusions}</div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {(selected.estimated_timeline || selected.payment_milestones || selected.maintenance_arrangements) && (
              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-2">Commercial terms</p>
                <div className="card !p-3 space-y-2.5 text-[13px]">
                  {selected.estimated_timeline && (
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mb-0.5">Timeline</p>
                      <p className="leading-relaxed">{selected.estimated_timeline}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {selected.payment_milestones && (
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mb-0.5">Payment milestones</p>
                      <p className="leading-relaxed">{selected.payment_milestones}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {selected.maintenance_arrangements && (
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mb-0.5">Maintenance</p>
                      <p className="leading-relaxed">{selected.maintenance_arrangements}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selected.expiration_date && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
                <Clock size={12} />
                <span>Expires {new Date(selected.expiration_date).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={showSheet}
        onClose={() => setShowSheet(false)}
        title="New Proposal"
        footer={
          <button type="submit" form="new-proposal-form" disabled={saving} className="btn-primary w-full">
            {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={18} /> : 'Save Proposal'}
          </button>
        }
      >
        <form id="new-proposal-form" onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-5">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <p className="eyebrow">Basics</p>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Title *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={title}
                onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="e.g. POS automation — ABC Restaurant"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Service description</label>
              <textarea
                value={serviceDescription}
                onChange={e => setServiceDescription(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="What we are proposing"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark">
            <p className="eyebrow">Solution</p>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Proposed solution</label>
              <textarea
                value={proposedSolution}
                onChange={e => setProposedSolution(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="How we will deliver it"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Scope of work</label>
              <textarea
                value={scope}
                onChange={e => setScope(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="What is included in the engagement"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Deliverables</label>
              <textarea
                value={deliverables}
                onChange={e => setDeliverables(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Exclusions</label>
              <textarea
                value={exclusions}
                onChange={e => setExclusions(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-surface-borderLight dark:border-surface-borderDark">
            <p className="eyebrow">Commercial</p>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Estimated timeline</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={timeline}
                onChange={e => setTimeline(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="e.g. 6 weeks"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Pricing</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  value={pricing}
                  onChange={e => setPricing(e.target.value)}
                  className="input-field font-mono"
                  placeholder="0"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Currency</label>
                <select value={currency} onChange={e => setCurrency(e.target.value)} className="input-field">
                  {CURRENCIES.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Payment milestones</label>
              <textarea
                value={milestones}
                onChange={e => setMilestones(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                placeholder="e.g. 50% upfront, 50% on delivery"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Maintenance arrangements</label>
              <textarea
                value={maintenance}
                onChange={e => setMaintenance(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
                rows={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[12px] font-medium mb-1.5">Expiration date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={expiration}
                onChange={e => setExpiration(e.target.value)}
                className="input-field"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { LEAD_STAGES, QUALIFIED_STAGES, DEAL_STAGES } from '../lib/stages';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Download, TrendingUp, Users, DollarSign, Calendar, Target, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type LeadRow = {
  id: string;
  stage: string;
  created_at: string;
  businesses: { industry: string | null; country: string | null; city: string | null } | null;
};

type DealRow = {
  id: string;
  stage: string;
  estimated_value: number | null;
  currency: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

type MeetingRow = {
  id: string;
  meeting_date: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
};

const RANGES = [
  { key: 'today', label: 'Today' },
  { key: 'week', label: 'This week' },
  { key: 'month', label: 'This month' },
  { key: 'quarter', label: 'This quarter' },
  { key: 'year', label: 'This year' },
] as const;
type RangeKey = typeof RANGES[number]['key'];







function rangeStart(key: RangeKey): Date {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (key === 'today') return d;
  if (key === 'week') {
    const day = d.getDay();
    const diff = (day + 6) % 7;
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - diff);
    return d;
  }
  if (key === 'month') { d.setDate(1); return d; }
  if (key === 'quarter') { d.setMonth(Math.floor(d.getMonth() / 3) * 3, 1); return d; }
  if (key === 'year') { d.setMonth(0, 1); return d; }
  return d;
}

function compact(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
  if (n >= 1_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
  return String(Math.round(n));
}

function KpiCard({ icon: Icon, label, value, tone, mono }: {
  icon: any; label: string; value: number | string;
  tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'brand'; mono?: boolean;
}) {
  const toneClass = {
    neutral: 'text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5',
    info: 'text-state-info bg-state-infoSoft',
    success: 'text-state-success bg-state-successSoft',
    brand: 'text-brand-primary bg-brand-primary/10',
  }[tone];
  return (
    <div className="card !p-3">
      <div className={'w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-2 ' + toneClass}>
        <Icon size={15} />
      </div>
      <p className="eyebrow mb-0.5 truncate">{label}</p>
      <p className={'text-[16px] md:text-[18px] font-bold tracking-tight leading-none truncate ' + (mono ? 'font-mono tabular-nums' : '')}>{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function Section({ title, subtitle, children }: { title: string; subtitle?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-5">
      <div className="mb-3">
        <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
        {subtitle && <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="card !p-4">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Bar({ label, count, max, tone }: { label: string; count: number; max: number; tone: string }) {
  const pct = Math.max(2, Math.round((count / max) * 100));
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[12px] mb-1">
        <span className="font-medium truncate">{label}</span>
        <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark shrink-0 ml-2">{count}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 overflow-hidden">
        <div className={'h-full rounded-full ' + tone} style={{ width: pct + '%' }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ icon: Icon, title, body }: { icon: any; title: string; body: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="py-16 text-center">
      <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
        <Icon size={28} />
      </div>
      <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">{title}</h3>
      <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">{body}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Reports() {

      supabase.from('deals').select('id, stage, estimated_value, currency, created_at'),
      supabase.from('meetings').select('id, meeting_date, status, created_at'),
    ]);
    if (leadsRes.data) setLeads(leadsRes.data as any);
    if (dealsRes.data) setDeals(dealsRes.data as any);
    if (meetingsRes.data) setMeetings(meetingsRes.data as any);

  }

  const filteredMeetings = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date >= startDateStr && m.status === 'Completed');

  const totalLeads = filteredLeads.length;
  const qualifiedLeads = filteredLeads.filter(l => QUALIFIED_STAGES.includes(l.stage)).length;
  const meetingsHeld = filteredMeetings.length;
  const wonDeals = filteredDeals.filter(d => d.stage === 'Won');
  const wonCount = wonDeals.length;
  const conversion = totalLeads > 0 ? Math.round((wonCount / totalLeads) * 100) : 0;

  const revByCur: Record<string, number> = {};
  wonDeals.forEach(d => {
    const c = d.currency || 'USD';
    revByCur[c] = (revByCur[c] || 0) + (d.estimated_value || 0);
  });
  const sortedCur = Object.entries(revByCur).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const dominantCurrency = sortedCur[0]?.[0] || 'USD';
  const dominantValue = sortedCur[0]?.[1] || 0;
  const otherCurrencies = Math.max(0, sortedCur.length - 1);

  const funnelData = LEAD_STAGES.map(stage => ({
    stage,
    count: filteredLeads.filter(l => l.stage === stage).length,
  }));
  const maxFunnel = Math.max(1, ...funnelData.map(f => f.count));

  const industryCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  filteredLeads.forEach(l => {
    const ind = l.businesses?.industry || 'Unknown';
    industryCounts[ind] = (industryCounts[ind] || 0) + 1;
  });
  const industryData = Object.entries(industryCounts)

    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
    .slice(0, 6);
  const maxIndustry = Math.max(1, ...industryData.map(i => i.count));

  const dealStageData = DEAL_STAGES.map(stage => ({
    stage,
    count: filteredDeals.filter(d => d.stage === stage).length,
  }));
  const maxDeal = Math.max(1, ...dealStageData.map(d => d.count));

  async function exportCSV() {
    try {
      const rows: (string | number)[][] = [
        ['BXB Sales Report'],
        ['Range', range],
        ['Generated', new Date().toISOString()],
        [],
        ['Metric', 'Value'],
        ['Total Leads', totalLeads],
        ['Qualified Leads', qualifiedLeads],
        ['Meetings Held', meetingsHeld],
        ['Won Deals', wonCount],
        ['Revenue (' + dominantCurrency + ')', dominantValue],
        ['Conversion Rate', conversion + '%'],
        [],
        ['Pipeline Funnel', 'Count'],
        ...funnelData.map(f => [f.stage, f.count]),
      ];
      const csv = rows.map(r => r.join(',')).join('\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'bxb-report-' + range + '-' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.csv';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast.success('Report exported');
      if (profile) {

          new_value: { range, totalLeads, wonCount },
        });
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Failed to export report');
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-5">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-24 rounded-2xl" />)}
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-56 rounded-2xl mb-4" />
        <SkeletonBox className="h-56 rounded-2xl" />
      </div>

  return (

      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Reports</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {totalLeads} leads · {wonCount} won
          </p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={exportCSV} className="btn-secondary shrink-0 !h-[38px] !text-[12px]">
          <Download size={14} /> Export
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        {RANGES.map(r => (

            {r.label}

        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mb-5">

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Plus, FileText, Search, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck, Download, Trash2, Folder } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Resource = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  category: string | null;
  file_path: string;
  file_size: number;
  created_at: string;
  author_id: string;
};

const CATEGORIES = [
  'Company', 'Sales Training', 'Playbooks', 'Templates',
  'Brochures', 'Portfolio', 'Video', 'Technical', 'Internal',
];

function fmtSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes) return '';
  if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
  if (bytes < 1048576) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
  return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
}

export default function Resources() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [resources, setResources] = useState<Resource[]>([]);
  const [bookmarks, setBookmarks] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [showBookmarks, setShowBookmarks] = useState(false);
  const [showSheet, setShowSheet] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [openingId, setOpeningId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [newCategory, setNewCategory] = useState('Sales Training');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';

  useEffect(() => { fetchAll(); }, []);

  async function fetchAll() {
    setLoading(true);
    const [resRes, bmRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('resources').select('id, title, description, category, file_path, file_size, created_at, author_id').is('deleted_at', null).order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      profile ? supabase.from('saved_resources').select('resource_id').eq('user_id', profile.id) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] })
    ]);
    if (resRes.data) setResources(resRes.data as any);
    if (bmRes.data) setBookmarks(new Set((bmRes.data as any[]).map(b => b.resource_id)));
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleUpload(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile || !file || !title) return;
    if (file.type !== 'application/pdf') { toast.error('Only PDF files are allowed'); return; }
    if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) { toast.error('File must be under 50 MB'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    const safeName = file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');
    const path = profile.team_id + '/' + Date.now() + '-' + safeName;
    const up = await supabase.storage.from('resources').upload(path, file);
    if (up.error) { toast.error('Upload failed: ' + up.error.message); setSaving(false); return; }
    const ins = await supabase.from('resources').insert({
      team_id: profile.team_id,
      author_id: profile.id,
      title,
      description: description || null,
      category: newCategory || null,
      file_path: path,
      file_size: file.size,
    });
    if (ins.error) { toast.error('Could not save record'); setSaving(false); return; }
    toast.success('Resource uploaded');
    setTitle(''); setDescription(''); setNewCategory('Sales Training'); setFile(null);
    setShowSheet(false);
    fetchAll();
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function openResource(r: Resource) {
    setOpeningId(r.id);
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from('resources').createSignedUrl(r.file_path, 3600);
    if (error || !data?.signedUrl) {
      toast.error('Could not open file');
    } else {
      window.open(data.signedUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    }
    setOpeningId(null);
  }

  async function toggleBookmark(r: Resource) {
    if (!profile) return;
    const isBm = bookmarks.has(r.id);
    const next = new Set(bookmarks);
    if (isBm) next.delete(r.id); else next.add(r.id);
    setBookmarks(next);
    if (isBm) {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('saved_resources').delete().eq('user_id', profile.id).eq('resource_id', r.id);
      if (error) { toast.error('Could not remove bookmark'); setBookmarks(new Set(bookmarks)); }
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('saved_resources').insert({ user_id: profile.id, resource_id: r.id });
      if (error) { toast.error('Could not save bookmark'); setBookmarks(new Set(bookmarks)); }
    }
  }

  async function handleDelete(r: Resource) {
    if (!confirm('Archive this resource? It will be hidden from members but the file remains in storage.')) return;
    const { error } = await supabase.from('resources').update({ deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', r.id);
    if (error) { toast.error('Could not archive'); return; }
    toast.success('Resource archived');
    fetchAll();
  }

  const categories = Array.from(new Set(resources.map(r => r.category).filter(Boolean))).sort() as string[];

  const filtered = resources.filter(r => {
    if (showBookmarks && !bookmarks.has(r.id)) return false;
    if (category !== 'All' && r.category !== category) return false;
    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      if (
        !r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !(r.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !(r.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl mb-3" />
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          {[0,1,2,3,4].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0,1,2,3].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-20 rounded-2xl" />)}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Resources</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {resources.length} file{resources.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · {bookmarks.size} saved
          </p>
        </div>
        {isAdmin && (
          <button onClick={() => setShowSheet(true)} className="btn-primary shrink-0">
            <Plus size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} /> Upload
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" size={18} />
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Search resources..."
          className="input-field pl-10"
          value={search}
          onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        <button onClick={() => { setShowBookmarks(false); setCategory('All'); }} className={!showBookmarks && category === 'All' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
          All
          <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{resources.length}</span>
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => setShowBookmarks(true)} className={showBookmarks ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
          <Bookmark size={13} /> Saved
          {bookmarks.size > 0 && <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{bookmarks.size}</span>}
        </button>
        {categories.map(c => (
          <button key={c} onClick={() => { setShowBookmarks(false); setCategory(c); }} className={!showBookmarks && category === c ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
            {c}
            <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">
              {resources.filter(r => r.category === c).length}
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <Folder size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">
            {showBookmarks ? 'No saved resources' : search ? 'No matching files' : 'No resources yet'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
            {showBookmarks ? 'Bookmark resources to find them here quickly.' : search ? 'Try a different search term or category.' : isAdmin ? 'Upload your first PDF from the button above.' : 'Ask your admin to upload sales material.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(r => {
            const isBm = bookmarks.has(r.id);
            return (

                  disabled={openingId === r.id}
                  className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-primary/10 text-brand-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 hover:bg-brand-primary/20 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                  aria-label={'Open ' + r.title}
                >
                  {openingId === r.id ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <FileText size={18} />}
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => openResource(r)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                  <h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug truncate">{r.title}</h3>
                  {r.description && (
                    <p className="text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark line-clamp-2 mb-1">{r.description}</p>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px]">
                    {r.category && <span className="badge-neutral">{r.category}</span>}
                    <span className="text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark font-mono tabular-nums">{fmtSize(r.file_size)}</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => toggleBookmark(r)}
                    className="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg active:bg-black/5 dark:active:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
                    aria-label={isBm ? 'Remove bookmark' : 'Save'}
                  >
                    {isBm ? <BookmarkCheck size={16} className="text-brand-primary" /> : <Bookmark size={16} className="text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" />}
                  </button>
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(r)}
                      className="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg active:bg-state-dangerSoft text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark hover:text-state-danger transition-colors"
                      aria-label="Archive"
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={15} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={showSheet}
        onClose={() => setShowSheet(false)}
        title="Upload Resource"
        footer={
          <button type="submit" form="upload-resource" disabled={saving} className="btn-primary w-full">
            {saving ? <><Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> Uploading…</> : <><Download size={16} /> Upload PDF</>}
          </button>
        }
      >
        <form id="upload-resource" onSubmit={handleUpload} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Title *</label>
            <input type="text" value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} className="input-field" placeholder="e.g. BXB Services Overview 2026" required />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Description</label>
            <textarea value={description} onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)} className="input-field" placeholder="Short description shown in the list" rows={2} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Category</label>
            <select value={newCategory} onChange={e => setNewCategory(e.target.value)} className="input-field">
              {CATEGORIES.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">PDF file * (max 50 MB)</label>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept="application/pdf"
              onChange={e => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              className="input-field file:mr-3 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-brand-primary file:text-black file:font-semibold file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-[12px]"
              required
            />
            {file && <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mt-1">{file.name} · {fmtSize(file.size)}</p>}
          </div>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
}

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Plus, Briefcase, Search, Pencil, Archive, ChevronRight, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Service = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  short_description: string | null;
  detailed_explanation: string | null;
  problems_solved: string | null;
  typical_clients: string | null;
  example_use_cases: string | null;
  required_info: string | null;
  common_questions: string | null;
  technical_limitations: string | null;
  marketing_description: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
};

const PRESET_CATEGORIES = [
  'AI Solutions', 'Business Automation', 'API Integrations', 'Custom Software',
  'Websites', 'Web Applications', 'UI/UX Design', 'Dashboards',
  'Business Management Systems', 'Digital Transformation', 'E-Marketing and Digital Services',
];

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  name: '',
  category: 'Websites',
  short_description: '',
  detailed_explanation: '',
  problems_solved: '',
  typical_clients: '',
  example_use_cases: '',
  required_info: '',
  common_questions: '',
  technical_limitations: '',
  marketing_description: '',
  is_active: true,
};

type FormState = typeof EMPTY_FORM;

export default function ServiceCatalogue() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [services, setServices] = useState<Service[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Service | null>(null);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Service | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [archiving, setArchiving] = useState(false);

  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';

  useEffect(() => { fetchServices(); }, []);

  async function fetchServices() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('service_catalog')
      .select('*')
      .order('is_active', { ascending: false })
      .order('name', { ascending: true });
    if (error) toast.error('Could not load services');
    if (data) setServices(data as any);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  function openAdd() {
    setEditing(null);
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  function openEdit(s: Service) {
    setEditing(s);
    setForm({
      name: s.name,
      category: s.category,
      short_description: s.short_description || '',
      detailed_explanation: s.detailed_explanation || '',
      problems_solved: s.problems_solved || '',
      typical_clients: s.typical_clients || '',
      example_use_cases: s.example_use_cases || '',
      required_info: s.required_info || '',
      common_questions: s.common_questions || '',
      technical_limitations: s.technical_limitations || '',
      marketing_description: s.marketing_description || '',
      is_active: s.is_active,
    });
    setShowForm(true);
    setSelected(null);
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.name.trim() || !form.category.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category.trim(),
      short_description: form.short_description.trim() || null,
      detailed_explanation: form.detailed_explanation.trim() || null,
      problems_solved: form.problems_solved.trim() || null,
      typical_clients: form.typical_clients.trim() || null,
      example_use_cases: form.example_use_cases.trim() || null,
      required_info: form.required_info.trim() || null,
      common_questions: form.common_questions.trim() || null,
      technical_limitations: form.technical_limitations.trim() || null,
      marketing_description: form.marketing_description.trim() || null,
      is_active: form.is_active,
    };
    const { error } = editing
      ? await supabase.from('service_catalog').update(payload).eq('id', editing.id)
      : await supabase.from('service_catalog').insert(payload);
    if (!error) {
      toast.success(editing ? 'Service updated' : 'Service created');
      setShowForm(false);
      setEditing(null);
      fetchServices();
    } else {
      toast.error(editing ? 'Could not update service' : 'Could not create service');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleArchive(s: Service) {
    if (!confirm('Archive "' + s.name + '"? It will be hidden from the catalogue.')) return;
    setArchiving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('service_catalog').update({ is_active: false }).eq('id', s.id);
    if (!error) {
      toast.success('Service archived');
      setSelected(null);
      fetchServices();
    } else {
      toast.error('Could not archive service');
    }
    setArchiving(false);
  }

  const categories = Array.from(new Set(services.map(s => s.category))).sort();
  const activeCount = services.filter(s => s.is_active).length;

  const filtered = services.filter(s => {
    if (category !== 'All' && s.category !== category) return false;
    if (!isAdmin && !s.is_active) return false;
    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      if (
        !s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !(s.short_description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !(s.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) &&
        !(s.marketing_description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl mb-3" />
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          {[0,1,2,3].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-9 w-24 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0,1,2,3].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="card p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
              <SkeletonBox className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl shrink-0" />
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                <SkeletonBox className="h-4 w-2/3" />
                <SkeletonBox className="h-3 w-1/2" />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Services</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {activeCount} active · {services.length} total
          </p>
        </div>
        {isAdmin && (
          <button onClick={openAdd} className="btn-primary shrink-0">
            <Plus size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} /> Add Service
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-3.5 text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark" size={18} />
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="Search services..."
          className="input-field pl-10"
          value={search}
          onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        <button
          onClick={() => setCategory('All')}
          className={category === 'All' ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}
        >
          All
          <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{services.length}</span>
        </button>
        {categories.map(c => (
          <button
            key={c}
            onClick={() => setCategory(c)}
            className={category === c ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}
          >
            {c}
            <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-70 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">
              {services.filter(s => s.category === c).length}
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <Briefcase size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">
            {search ? 'No matching services' : category !== 'All' ? 'No services in this category' : 'No services yet'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[280px] mx-auto">
            {search
              ? 'Try a different search term.'
              : category !== 'All'
                ? 'Switch to All to see every service.'
                : isAdmin
                  ? 'Add your first service from the button above.'
                  : 'Your admin has not added services yet.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(s => (
            <button
              key={s.id}
              onClick={() => setSelected(s)}
              className={'card p-3 w-full text-left flex items-start gap-3 active:scale-[0.995] transition-all ' + (!s.is_active ? 'opacity-60' : 'hover:border-brand-primary/30')}
            >

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="badge-neutral">{s.category}</span>
                  {s.is_active ? (
                    <span className="badge-success">Active</span>

                    <span className="badge-neutral">Inactive</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title={selected?.name || 'Service'}
      >

                    <p className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{selected.marketing_description}</p>

              </div>

            {selected.short_description && (

                  {selected.example_use_cases && (

                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mb-0.5">Example use cases</p>
                      <p className="leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{selected.example_use_cases}</p>

            {(selected.required_info || selected.common_questions) && (

                      <p className="leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{selected.required_info}</p>

            <div>

            <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
              <div>
                <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Active</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark">Visible to reps in the catalogue</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, is_active: !form.is_active })}
                className={'relative w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors ' + (form.is_active ? 'bg-brand-primary' : 'bg-black/20 dark:bg-white/20')}
              >
                <span className={'absolute top-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform ' + (form.is_active ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0.5')} />
              </button>
            </label>
          </div>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { localToday } from '../lib/date';
import { QUALIFIED_STAGES } from '../lib/stages';
import { supabase } from '../supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { Loader2, Plus, Target as TargetIcon, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { BottomSheet } from '../components/BottomSheet';
import { SkeletonBox } from '../components/Skeleton';
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast';

type Target = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  target_type: string;
  scope: string;
  scope_id: string | null;
  target_value: number;
  period_start: string;
  period_end: string;
  created_by: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  created_at: string;
};

const TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  prospects: 'New prospects',
  qualified: 'Qualified leads',
  meetings: 'Meetings held',
  handovers: 'Handovers',
  proposals: 'Proposals sent',
  won: 'Deals won',
};

function statusOf(t: Target) {
  const today = localToday();
  if (!t.is_active) return 'Archived';
  if (t.period_end < today) return 'Ended';
  if (t.period_start > today) return 'Upcoming';
  return 'Active';
}
function statusBadge(s: string) {
  if (s === 'Active') return 'badge-success';
  if (s === 'Upcoming') return 'badge-info';
  if (s === 'Ended') return 'badge-neutral';
  return 'badge-neutral';
}

type Filter = 'all' | 'active' | 'ended';

export default function Targets() {
  const { profile } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [targets, setTargets] = useState<Target[]>([]);
  const [actuals, setActuals] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Target | null>(null);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all');
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<{ id: string; username: string }[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [targetType, setTargetType] = useState('prospects');
  const [scope, setScope] = useState('individual');
  const [scopeId, setScopeId] = useState('');
  const [targetValue, setTargetValue] = useState('');
  const [periodStart, setPeriodStart] = useState('');
  const [periodEnd, setPeriodEnd] = useState('');

  const isAdmin = profile?.role === 'admin';

  useEffect(() => { fetchAll(); }, [profile]);

  async function fetchAll() {
    setLoading(true);
    const [targetsRes, leadsRes, meetingsRes, dealsRes, profilesRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('sales_targets').select('*').order('is_active', { ascending: false }).order('period_end', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('leads').select('id, stage, assigned_to, created_at'),
      supabase.from('meetings').select('id, status, assigned_to, meeting_date'),
      supabase.from('deals').select('id, stage, assigned_to, created_at'),
      isAdmin ? supabase.from('profiles').select('id, username').order('username') : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
    ]);
    const tList = (targetsRes.data || []) as Target[];
    setTargets(tList);
    if (profilesRes.data) setProfiles(profilesRes.data as any);

    const leads = (leadsRes.data || []) as any[];
    const meetings = (meetingsRes.data || []) as any[];
    const deals = (dealsRes.data || []) as any[];
    

    const result: Record<string, number> = {};
    tList.forEach(t => {
      const inRange = (d: string) => d >= t.period_start && d <= t.period_end;
      const matchesScope = (row: any) => {
        if (t.scope === 'global') return true;
        if (t.scope === 'individual') return row.assigned_to === t.scope_id;
        return true;
      };
      let count = 0;
      if (t.target_type === 'prospects') {
        count = leads.filter(l => matchesScope(l) && inRange(l.created_at.split('T')[0])).length;
      } else if (t.target_type === 'qualified') {
        count = leads.filter(l => matchesScope(l) && inRange(l.created_at.split('T')[0]) && QUALIFIED_STAGES.includes(l.stage)).length;
      } else if (t.target_type === 'meetings') {
        count = meetings.filter(m => matchesScope(m) && inRange(m.meeting_date) && m.status === 'Completed').length;
      } else if (t.target_type === 'won') {
        count = deals.filter(d => matchesScope(d) && inRange(d.created_at.split('T')[0]) && d.stage === 'Won').length;
      }
      result[t.id] = count;
    });
    setActuals(result);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!profile || !title || !targetValue || !periodStart || !periodEnd) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('sales_targets').insert({
      title,
      description: description || null,
      target_type: targetType,
      scope,
      scope_id: scope === 'individual' ? (scopeId || profile.id) : null,
      target_value: parseInt(targetValue, 10),
      period_start: periodStart,
      period_end: periodEnd,
      created_by: profile.id,
      is_active: true,
    });
    if (!error) {
      toast.success('Target created');
      setTitle(''); setDescription(''); setTargetType('prospects'); setScope('individual');
      setScopeId(''); setTargetValue(''); setPeriodStart(''); setPeriodEnd('');
      setShowForm(false);
      fetchAll();
    } else {
      toast.error('Could not create target');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  const filtered = targets.filter(t => {
    const s = statusOf(t);
    if (filter === 'active') return s === 'Active';
    if (filter === 'ended') return s === 'Ended' || s === 'Archived';
    return true;
  });

  const activeCount = targets.filter(t => statusOf(t) === 'Active').length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
          <SkeletonBox className="h-8 w-32" />
          <SkeletonBox className="h-11 w-24 rounded-xl" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-5">
          {[0,1,2].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-9 w-20 rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0,1,2].map(i => <SkeletonBox key={i} className="h-28 rounded-2xl" />)}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 md:p-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto animate-enter">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5 md:mb-6 gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="page-title">Targets</h1>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
            {activeCount} active · {targets.length} total
          </p>
        </div>
        {isAdmin && (
          <button onClick={() => setShowForm(true)} className="btn-primary shrink-0">
            <Plus size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} /> New Target
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 pb-1 mb-5 scrollbar-hide">
        {([
          { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
          { key: 'active', label: 'Active' },
          { key: 'ended', label: 'Ended' },
        ] as { key: Filter; label: string }[]).map(f => (
          <button key={f.key} onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)} className={filter === f.key ? 'chip-active' : 'chip'}>
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-brand-primary/10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 mx-auto text-brand-primary">
            <TargetIcon size={28} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold mb-1">No targets</h3>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark max-w-[260px] mx-auto">
            {isAdmin ? 'Create a target from the button above.' : 'Your admin has not set targets yet.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map(t => {
            const s = statusOf(t);
            const actual = actuals[t.id] || 0;
            const pct = t.target_value > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((actual / t.target_value) * 100)) : 0;
            const barTone = pct >= 100 ? 'bg-state-success' : pct >= 50 ? 'bg-brand-primary' : 'bg-brand-primary/60';
            return (
              <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setSelected(t)} className="card p-3 w-full text-left hover:border-brand-primary/30 active:scale-[0.995] transition-all">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                  <h3 className="text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-tight flex-1 min-w-0 truncate">{t.title}</h3>
                  <span className={statusBadge(s)}>{s}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[12px] mb-1.5">
                  <span className="text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark truncate">
                    {TYPE_LABELS[t.target_type] || t.target_type}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold shrink-0 ml-2">
                    {actual} / {t.target_value}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 overflow-hidden mb-1.5">
                  <div className={'h-full rounded-full ' + barTone} style={{ width: pct + '%' }} />
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark font-mono tabular-nums">
                  {new Date(t.period_start).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} – {new Date(t.period_end).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                </p>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title={selected?.title || 'Target'}
      >
        {selected && (() => {
          const actual = actuals[selected.id] || 0;
          const pct = selected.target_value > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((actual / selected.target_value) * 100)) : 0;
          const owner = profiles.find(p => p.id === selected.scope_id);
          return (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className={statusBadge(statusOf(selected))}>{statusOf(selected)}</span>
                <span className="badge-neutral">{TYPE_LABELS[selected.target_type] || selected.target_type}</span>
                <span className="badge-neutral">{selected.scope === 'individual' ? (owner?.username || 'Individual') : selected.scope}</span>
              </div>

              {selected.description && (
                <div>
                  <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Description</p>
                  <div className="card !p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{selected.description}</div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <p className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Progress</p>
                <div className="card !p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-end justify-between mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[24px] font-bold font-mono tabular-nums tracking-tight leading-none">{actual}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-mutedLight dark:text-text-mutedDark mt-0.5">of {selected.target_value}</p>

                    <span className="text-[20px] font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-brand-primary">{pct}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 overflow-hidden">

                  </div>

              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-text-secondaryLight dark:text-text-secondaryDark">
                <Calendar size={12} />
                <span>
                  {new Date(selected.period_start).toLocaleDateString()} – {new Date(selected.period_end).toLocaleDateString()}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })()}
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet
        isOpen={showForm}
        onClose={() => setShowForm(false)}
        title="New Target"
        footer={
          <button type="submit" form="new-target" disabled={saving} className="btn-primary w-full">
            {saving ? <><Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> Saving…</> : 'Create Target'}
          </button>
        }
      >
        <form id="new-target" onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Title *</label>
            <input type="text" value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} className="input-field" placeholder="e.g. November qualifying sprint" required />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Description</label>
            <textarea value={description} onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)} className="input-field" placeholder="Optional context" rows={2} />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Metric *</label>
              <select value={targetType} onChange={e => setTargetType(e.target.value)} className="input-field">
                {Object.entries(TYPE_LABELS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
              </select>

            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Target *</label>
              <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={targetValue} onChange={e => setTargetValue(e.target.value)} className="input-field font-mono" placeholder="20" required />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">Scope</label>

            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="eyebrow block mb-1.5">End *</label>
              <input type="date" value={periodEnd} onChange={e => setPeriodEnd(e.target.value)} className="input-field" required />
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
